The ingredients were fresh, and the flavors complemented each other well. Overall, a great dining experience with excellent food and ambiance, making it an ideal spot for a relaxing Sunday morning breakfast with family or friends.

The lack of attention to our reservation and the subsequent wait was frustrating enough, but the subpar food and poor service only added to our disappointment. It's unacceptable for a restaurant to not honor a reservation, especially for a large group celebrating a special occasion. The fact that the staff seemed unapologetic and unaccommodating made the experience even more infuriating. The suggestion to stand and eat off to the side was not only impractical but also insulting, especially considering we had made a reservation in advance. The new pizza menu was a letdown, and the removal of the BBQ pizza was a mistake. The few pizzas we ordered were hit or miss, with only the Margherita pizza being worth the price. The over-salting of the other pizzas and the underwhelming presentation of the bacon and eggs pizza were major disappointments. The fact that the egg yolk was hard and not runny, as expected, was a minor but telling detail that spoke to the kitchen's lack of attention to detail. Overall, our experience was a disaster from start to finish. The combination of poor service, subpar food, and lack of accountability has left a sour taste in our mouths. Unless they revamp their reservation system, menu, and service, we will not be returning to this restaurant for weekday late nights. A simple gesture of goodwill, such as a complimentary drink or dessert, would have gone a long way in mitigating the damage, but alas, that was not to be. Needless to say, our birthday celebration was not the memorable experience we had hoped for.

Overall, it was an enjoyable evening, but not worth the full price. The show's energy was high, and the performers were talented, but it didn't exceed my expectations. My parents, however, were thoroughly entertained and thought it was worth every penny. If you can get discounted tickets, it's definitely worth considering, but be cautious of the full-priced tickets, as they may not provide the same value.

The atmosphere is casual and lively, making it a great spot to catch a game or meet up with friends. The drink selection is decent, with a variety of beers and cocktails available. Overall, Gin Mill is a reliable choice for a low-key night out in Southend, just don't expect anything fancy and be prepared for a lively crowd.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it perfect for a night out with friends. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, helping to guide you through the menu. With its unique sharing concept and delicious dishes, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to mix things up and try something new. Overall, I'm hooked and will definitely be back for more.

As we continued to enjoy our time at Stripper Bar, we noticed the unique dynamic between the staff and the patrons. Everyone seemed to be having a great time, and the atmosphere was lively and welcoming. The strip lessons that started after the game were definitely a highlight, and it was impressive to see the staff's energy and enthusiasm. We even participated in a few lessons, which added to the overall entertainment value of our visit. The prices at Stripper Bar were also a major plus, with affordable drinks and food options that didn't break the bank. The bucket of beers for $15 was an exceptional deal, and the chips and salsa and chicken strips we ordered were tasty and satisfying. The service was top-notch, with Tara and the other staff member always attentive and friendly. Overall, our experience at Stripper Bar was a pleasant surprise, especially after being rejected by Blondie's across the way. We appreciated the warm welcome and the effort the staff put into making sure we had a good time. With its convenient location in the mall, affordable prices, and entertaining atmosphere, Stripper Bar is definitely a spot we'll be returning to in the future. Whether you're looking for a fun place to watch a game or just want to grab a drink and enjoy some lively entertainment, Stripper Bar is worth checking out.
The selection is also limited, making it an overall disappointing experience, not worth the expensive prices or rude staff, go elsewhere for better quality and service.

As we sat in our hotel room, savoring the last bites of our lunch, I couldn't help but think that Olive et Gourmando had truly outdone themselves. The combination of flavors, textures, and presentation was spot on, and the chaotic atmosphere only added to the charm. It's clear that this place is a labor of love, and the attention to detail is evident in every aspect of the dining experience. One of the things that really stood out to me was the quality of the ingredients. The brie was creamy and rich, the caramelized onions were sweet and depthful, and the braised pork in the Cuban sandwich was tender and full of flavor. You can tell that the chefs at Olive et Gourmando are passionate about using only the best ingredients, and it makes all the difference in the world. I also appreciated the creativity of the menu. The combination of flavors and ingredients in each sandwich was unique and exciting, and the presentation was beautiful. The fact that they were willing to think outside the box and try new things is refreshing, and it's clear that they're not afraid to take risks. Of course, no review of Olive et Gourmando would be complete without mentioning the famous triple chocolate cookie. Oh. My. God. This cookie is a game-changer. The generous amounts of real chocolate chips are perfectly balanced by the richness of the cookie itself, and the texture is perfect. It's chewy, but not too chewy, and it's clear that the chefs have put a lot of thought into getting the recipe just right. As we finished up our lunch and prepared to head out for the rest of the day, I couldn't help but feel grateful for the experience. Olive et Gourmando is truly a special place, and it's clear that they're dedicated to providing their customers with an exceptional dining experience. If you're in the Old Port area, do yourself a favor and stop by. Trust me, you won't be disappointed. In fact, I would go so far as to say that Olive et Gourmando has set the bar high for all future dining experiences. The combination of delicious food, charming atmosphere, and exceptional service is a tough act to follow, and I have a feeling that we'll be comparing all future meals to this one. But hey, that's not a bad problem to have. All in all, I would highly recommend Olive et Gourmando to anyone looking for a unique and delicious dining experience. It's a must-try if you're in the area, and it's clear that the chefs and staff are dedicated to providing their customers with an exceptional experience. So go ahead, brave the chaos, and get ready for a truly unforgettable meal. Your taste buds will thank you.

As I continued to browse through the store, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and frustration with the encounter I had just experienced. The rest of the store seemed to be running smoothly, with friendly and helpful staff in other departments. However, the men's suits area was a different story altogether. The salesman's attitude and behavior were completely unacceptable, and it's not what I expect from a retailer like Macy's. I understand that mistakes can happen, but it's how they're handled that matters. In this case, the situation was handled poorly, and it left a bad taste in my mouth. I ended up finding a new pair of pants to replace the ones with the broken zipper, but the experience was tainted by the interaction with the salesman. I hope that in the future, Macy's will take steps to ensure that their staff provides excellent customer service, regardless of the situation. A simple bottle of water may seem like a small thing, but it's the principle of the matter that counts. As a customer, I expect to be treated with respect and kindness, even if my request is denied. Unfortunately, my experience at the Macy's men's suits area fell short of those expectations, and I will be taking my business elsewhere.
Prices are reasonable, but the overall experience lacks a memorable touch, leaving me underwhelmed and unlikely to return anytime soon for another lackluster dinner.
Overhyped and underwhelming experience, lacking authenticity and value, making it a disappointing choice for bagel enthusiasts, ultimately doomed by poor business decisions.

Overall, our experience at this restaurant was a letdown, especially considering their claim of being a BBQ joint. The atmosphere, although unique and entertaining for kids, couldn't make up for the subpar food. I appreciate the effort to create a fun environment, but it's essential to deliver on the culinary front, especially when advertising a specific type of cuisine. The friendly waitress was a notable exception, providing attentive service despite the kitchen's shortcomings. If they revamped their menu to focus on a few key items and improved the quality of their BBQ, I might consider giving them another chance. As it stands, I would not recommend this spot to anyone seeking authentic BBQ. Perhaps they could cater more to their apparent strength in comfort food, like the mac and cheese, and abandon the BBQ pretenses. Until then, I'll take my BBQ cravings (and my family) elsewhere.

The variety of activities kept everyone entertained, and the staff were friendly and helpful. We spent hours here and still didn't get to try everything. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the range of options available. Overall, it was a great way to spend a sunny day with family and friends, and we would definitely return for another fun-filled visit.

I was extremely disappointed in the way the situation was handled, as it seemed like an attempted scam. The lack of transparency and communication from the manager was unprofessional. I had been enjoying my meal and was willing to leave a generous tip, but the shady behavior at the end left a bad taste in my mouth. The waiter seemed unaware of the issue and was friendly, but the manager's actions overshadowed the positive aspects of my visit. Unfortunately, this experience has made me hesitant to return to this establishment. The food may be good, but trust is essential.

I was thoroughly unimpressed with the way Travis handled my concerns, and it's clear that the hotel's priorities lie in maintaining a false image rather than actually addressing the problems. The fact that he tried to justify their four-star rating by listing amenities like suites, restaurants, and a spa, while acknowledging that their standard rooms are subpar, speaks volumes about their values. It's laughable that they think having a spa and restaurant automatically warrants a four-star rating, regardless of the quality of their rooms. The attempt to deflect my criticism by suggesting that I must be mistaken about the mold and mildew was also telling. If they're so confident in their cleaning schedule, why did Travis eventually admit that it was indeed mildew? It's clear that they're more interested in saving face than in taking genuine steps to improve their guests' experiences. The suggestion that I should call Travis directly to book a room, despite the fact that I'd just expressed my disgust with the conditions, was the final nail in the coffin. Needless to say, I will be taking my business (and my star rating) elsewhere. The Hyatt and La Quinta are looking like much more appealing options, with their comparable room quality, better amenities, and lack of resort fees. One star is even too generous for this hotel – if I could, I'd give them a big fat zero.
Rude staff can really ruin the dining experience, making the good food irrelevant and leaving a bad impression that's hard to shake.

Maybe it was just an off day, but the lack of attention was noticeable. I've been to many restaurants with excellent service, so this experience stood out. Despite the delicious food, the subpar service left a sour taste. I hope they'll work on providing more equal and attentive service to all customers, regardless of background.

Overall, our experience at this steak house was a mixed bag. While the steaks were indeed tasty, the inconsistency in cooking them to our desired level of doneness was a letdown. The great sides and decent bread basket were notable highlights, but the subpar service really detracted from our overall enjoyment. For a high-end establishment, we expected more attentive and patient wait staff. Our waitress's rushed demeanor and apparent disinterest in addressing our questions made us feel like we were an inconvenience. Given the hefty price tag, we anticipated a more refined and accommodating experience. Unfortunately, this steak house fell short of our expectations, leaving us uncertain about whether we'd return in the future.

The beds were uncomfortable and the noise from the highway was noticeable. Overall, the cons outweigh the pros, making it an overpriced option for the quality provided. Unless significant changes are made, I would not recommend staying here, especially with other nearby hotels offering better amenities and services.

I'm still fuming as I write this review, recalling the disastrous experience my party and I had at this establishment. The lack of greeting, the confusion over seating, and the disappearance of our waiter set the tone for a meal that was subpar in every aspect. The fact that our order was incorrect and our side dishes arrived at the end of the meal was just the beginning. The food itself was a major letdown - the beans tasted like they came straight from a can, and the tacos were no better than what you'd find at a fast-food chain like Del Taco. What's even more astonishing is that a place that claims to serve authentic, flavorful cuisine can't even get the basics right. The lack of flavor in every dish was staggering, and the presentation was lackluster at best. It's clear that the kitchen is not taking any pride in their work, and the food is suffering as a result. But the service - or rather, the lack thereof - was the final nail in the coffin. Our waiter's disappearance was baffling, and the fact that we had to flag down the busboy to get any attention at all was embarrassing. When I finally got up to pay the bill at the front of the restaurant, I was met with a dismissive owner who seemed completely unbothered by our horrible experience. The fact that our waiter magically reappeared as we were leaving, only to present us with a revised bill, was just a slap in the face. The cherry on top of this disastrous experience was the food poisoning I contracted, which I'm still recovering from as I write this review. It's inexcusable that a restaurant can't even ensure the safety of their food, let alone provide decent service and cuisine. My advice to anyone considering dining at this establishment is to steer clear - there are far better places to spend your money, where the food is delicious, the service is attentive, and the overall experience is enjoyable. Don't make the same mistake I did - avoid this place at all costs. The owner's lack of concern and the waiter's ineptitude are a clear indication that this restaurant is not worth your time or money. Save yourself the hassle and the risk of food poisoning - DONT GO HERE!

As I reflected on my dining experience, I realized that the simplicity of the venue actually added to the overall charm of the place. The lack of distractions allowed me to focus on the food, which was undoubtedly the star of the show. The pulled pork, in particular, was a revelation - the smoky flavor and tender texture were a perfect combination. I appreciated that the chef didn't rely on sauces to mask the flavor of the meat, instead letting the quality of the ingredients shine through. The waffle fries, too, were a highlight of the meal. The seasoning was spot on, and the crispy exterior gave way to a fluffy interior that was simply addictive. I could easily see myself ordering a double portion of these on my next visit, as I mentioned earlier. The mac'n cheese, while not as show-stopping as the pulled pork or waffle fries, was still a solid side dish that complemented the rest of the meal nicely. One of the things that impressed me most about Pork on a Fork was the clear attention to detail in the kitchen. From the perfectly cooked pulled pork to the crispy waffle fries, it was clear that the chef was dedicated to serving up high-quality dishes. This attention to detail extended to the mac'n cheese, which, as I mentioned earlier, was clearly made in-house rather than relying on a pre-made supplier. In terms of value, I was more than happy to pay the $11 for my meal. The portion sizes were generous, and the quality of the food was well worth the price. As I mentioned earlier, you can certainly find cheaper options elsewhere, but you get what you pay for. In this case, the extra few dollars were well worth it for the delicious, satisfying meal I enjoyed. Overall, I'm so glad I stumbled upon Pork on a Fork. It's clear that the restaurant is dedicated to serving up delicious, high-quality barbecue, and I'm excited to go back and try more of the menu items. Whether you're a barbecue aficionado or just looking for a tasty, satisfying meal, Pork on a Fork is definitely worth a visit. I'll be back soon to try more of the menu and see if the restaurant can continue to impress!

I am absolutely appalled and disappointed by the experience I had with this groomer. Not only did they seem to have inconsistent pricing and poor record-keeping, but they also apparently caused harm to my dog. The fact that my 6-pound dog came out of there with a severe skin infection that required two trips to the vet and medication is unacceptable. As a pet owner, it's my responsibility to ensure my dogs receive the best care possible, and this groomer failed to meet those expectations. What's even more disturbing is that my vet informed me that this is not an isolated incident, and they've had another complaint about this groomer before. This raises serious concerns about the groomer's hygiene and sanitation practices, as well as their ability to handle dogs with care and compassion. The fact that they seemed more concerned with defending their business practices than taking responsibility for their actions and apologizing for the harm caused to my dog is appalling. I want to warn other pet owners about the potential risks of taking their dogs to this groomer. The initial low prices may seem appealing, but the consequences can be severe and long-lasting. I will never take my dogs back to this groomer, and I would advise others to think twice before doing so. The health and well-being of our pets are too important to be taken lightly, and we deserve better than a groomer who seems to prioritize their own interests over the care and safety of the animals in their charge. I hope that by sharing my experience, I can prevent others from going through the same ordeal and help them make informed decisions about their pet's care.

Overall, we were satisfied with our dining experience. The prices were reasonable and the portion sizes were generous. Our server was attentive and friendly, ensuring that our glasses were always full. The restaurant's atmosphere was casual and comfortable, making it a great spot to grab a bite before a show. We would definitely consider returning to this restaurant in the future.

The dim lighting and intimate setting added to the unique charm of the place. Our group enjoyed the eclectic decor and lively tunes playing in the background. Although it was crowded, the staff managed to keep up with our large group's orders and were attentive to our needs. Overall, Frankie's Tiki Room is a hidden gem that's perfect for a night out with friends or a quirky date spot. I'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and laid-back experience with great drinks and a cool vibe.

The overall experience was a letdown, and I would not recommend Bayside Buffet to anyone looking for a quality buffet in Vegas. The price point of $30 for dinner is not justified by the subpar food options. I've had better luck at other buffets in the area that offer fresher, more flavorful dishes at a similar price. The lack of seasoning on the prime rib was particularly disappointing, and the dry, overcooked fried chicken was a major turnoff. Even the desserts, which are usually a highlight of any buffet, were a disappointment. The fact that the ice cream machine wasn't even functioning properly was just the cherry on top of a lackluster experience. Unless they revamp their menu and improve their food quality, I would advise others to steer clear of Bayside Buffet and opt for one of the many other, better buffet options in Vegas.

The lack of attention to detail and declining food quality makes it a disappointing experience. With so many other excellent options available, I won't be returning anytime soon. Sadly, this once-convenient spot has become a letdown, and I hope they can turn things around to regain their former reputation and customer satisfaction.

My first experience here wasn't bad..... I just thought the food was OK on average. Nothing to special about it. It's pretty much your typical American Mexican joint. From the name, I guess I was just expecting a lot. Location - located on a strip mall right next to a gas station and other food joints. Corner of Decatur and Sunset. Atmosphere - the place is small but it's pretty clean and cozy. It was pretty busy when I went during lunch hour. Food - I'm a nocturnal type of person so I always wake up late. I was craving some type of Mexican breakfast and I came across this place. I had the Chorizo breakfast burrito with a side of Barbacoa taco. Like I mentioned earlier, I thought the food was average. Prices are decent and it's something you'd expect from a place like this. I've had better ones at a local Roberto's. Service - no complaints on service. It's the typical order from the counter, pay and they'll being the food to you type of shindig. It was pretty prompt and the lady was quite nice. Overall, I'd probably give this place another go. Maybe for something quick or maybe to try their famous chocolate drizzled churro. If you're looking for Mexican food or some type of Mex fusion, I'd go somewhere else. Perhaps I just caught them on an off day, but I didn't feel like the dishes I ordered were particularly impressive or memorable. The Chorizo breakfast burrito was filling, but it lacked a certain depth of flavor that I've come to expect from a good Mexican breakfast dish. The Barbacoa taco was tender, but it was somewhat overpowered by the salsa and other toppings. I do appreciate the convenience of the location and the friendly service, so I might be willing to give them another chance to see if they can impress me with something else on the menu. The chocolate drizzled churro sounds like a nice treat, and I've heard good things about it from other reviewers. However, for now, I would say that this place is just average, and there are likely better options available for those seeking authentic or innovative Mexican cuisine.

Overall, my experience at this venue was underwhelming. The combination of inexperienced staff, a novice DJ, and a rowdy crowd made for a chaotic and unpleasant atmosphere. The rooftop bar, which I had been looking forward to, was a major letdown with its unimpressive views. It's a shame, really, because the location at Caesar's Palace suggests a level of sophistication and luxury that this place just doesn't deliver. Unless you're part of the younger crowd that seems to thrive in this environment, I would recommend exploring other options on the Strip. With a little more attention to service and ambiance, this place could reach its full potential, but for now, it's just a disappointing and overhyped spot.

As I stood there, savoring the last bite of that incredible mac & cheese, I knew I had found my new go-to spot for soul food. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with the aroma of slow-cooked meats and spices filling the air. The staff's enthusiasm was contagious, making me feel like I was part of a big, happy family. I ended up ordering a few more items, including the fried chicken and collard greens, both of which were equally impressive. The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. Overall, I'm so glad I stumbled upon this hidden gem at SouthPark Mall. If you're a fan of authentic, delicious soul food, do yourself a favor and stop by – your taste buds will thank you! I'm already planning my next visit. Five stars, hands down!
Delicious, freshly made, and reasonably priced, these sandwiches are a must-try, perfect for a quick bite or late-night craving after a night out.

I left feeling underwhelmed and overhyped about the whole experience. The atmosphere was quaint, but the food fell short of my expectations. Perhaps I visited on an off day, but the dry meat was a major letdown. For a place that's supposed to be famous for its sandwiches, I expected a lot more. The combination of the cherry coke, fries, and pickle was a nice touch, but it couldn't make up for the subpar sandwich. If you're looking for a truly exceptional deli experience, I would still recommend trying Katz in NYC. The price difference may seem significant, but trust me, it's worth every penny.

The utter disappointment and disgust I felt after dining at Hikari still lingers, and I feel compelled to warn others, especially fellow vegetarians, about the subpar experience that awaits them. It's not just the lack of options that's the problem, but the sheer incompetence in preparing the few vegetarian dishes they do offer. The vegetable tempura was an affront to the culinary world, and the mochi ice cream was an insult to the concept of frozen desserts. I've had my fair share of mediocre meals at Japanese restaurants, but Hikari takes the cake for its breathtaking ability to mess up even the simplest of dishes. The fact that they managed to serve freezer-burned mochi ice cream is a testament to their lack of attention to detail and commitment to quality. As someone who's willing to give restaurants the benefit of the doubt, I'm shocked that I'm still fuming about my experience months later. To the owners of Hikari, I implore you: take a long, hard look at your kitchen and your staff, and ask yourselves if you're truly doing justice to the culinary traditions you're supposed to be representing. Until then, I'll make sure to steer clear of your establishment and advise others to do the same. One star is even too generous for a place that has so blatantly disregarded the basics of cooking and customer satisfaction.
Food was decent, prices reasonable, and atmosphere cozy, but service inconsistencies left a mixed impression overall.

Prices were reasonable, and portion sizes were generous. Overall, I'm excited to try more menu items and experience their great service again, hopefully with fresher avocado next time, to make it a perfect dining experience.

The technicians are skilled and gentle, making the experience comfortable and relaxing. They have a wide range of gel polish colors to choose from, and I've never had an issue with them getting the color right. The salon itself is clean and well-maintained, which is important to me. Overall, I'm happy with the service and quality I receive, and I plan to continue going back for my gel manicure needs. The moderate pricing and long-lasting results make it a great value for me, and I would recommend this salon to others looking for a reliable and skilled gel manicure experience.

I've had the pleasure of trying various items on their menu, and I must say that their consistency in quality is impressive. The soups, sandwiches, and flatbreads are all delicious and made with fresh ingredients. I also appreciate their commitment to sustainability and reducing food waste. The fact that they donate unsold bread and pastries to those in need is truly admirable. As someone who has been a customer and an employee, I can confidently say that Panera Bread is a company that genuinely cares about its community. Whether I'm grabbing a quick breakfast on-the-go or meeting friends for lunch, Panera Bread is always my top choice. The combination of tasty food, welcoming atmosphere, and friendly staff makes it the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy some well-deserved relaxation. Overall, I highly recommend Panera Bread to anyone looking for a great dining experience that also supports a good cause.

Overall, my experience at this establishment was underwhelming, to say the least. The lack of customers should have been a red flag, but I was willing to give them a chance. Unfortunately, the service was slow and the staff seemed uninterested in attending to my needs. The food, which I was initially excited to try, was a major letdown. The pork chops were the only redeeming quality, but the sides were a disaster. The mac and cheese was a lazy, processed rendition that lacked any real flavor or effort, while the greens were a flavorless, unseasoned mess. For $13.00, I expect a lot more quality and care in the preparation of my meal. Sadly, this place did not deliver, and I would not recommend it to anyone. Unless they seriously revamp their menu and service, I don't see myself returning anytime soon. The lack of attention to detail and commitment to quality is disappointing, and I hope they take customer feedback seriously to make necessary improvements.
Overpriced and underwhelming experience, definitely not worth the hefty bill or the time spent waiting in line either unfortunately always.

I've been to numerous play cafes in the past, but Kids Play Cafe truly stands out from the rest. The attention to detail and commitment to providing a safe and enjoyable environment for both children and adults is evident in every aspect of the facility. From the carefully curated play areas to the healthy and delicious food options, it's clear that the owners have put a lot of thought into creating a space that caters to the needs of families. The play structure, which is made in the US, is not only fun for kids but also sturdy and well-maintained. The staff is always on hand to ensure that everything is running smoothly and that all the children are having a great time. The free WIFI and comfortable seating areas make it easy for parents to relax and get some work done while their kids play. Overall, I'm so impressed with Kids Play Cafe and feel grateful to have it in our neighborhood. It's become our go-to spot for a fun and stress-free day out with our daughter, and I highly recommend it to all my friends and fellow parents. With its unique blend of play, food, and community, Kids Play Cafe is a must-visit destination for any family looking for a great time.

I've lost count of how many times we've had to ask for refills on drinks or follow up on orders that seem to have been forgotten. The staff seems overwhelmed and disorganized, even when the restaurant isn't busy. For a place that's supposedly convenient for a work lunch, it's astonishing how inefficient they are. Two hours is just unacceptable for a meal that's not even enjoyable. Unless they seriously revamp their service and quality of food, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Needless to say, we'll be taking our team lunches (and our business) elsewhere from now on.

The sense of community at Sicfit is unparalleled, with everyone supporting and encouraging each other to reach their full potential. The trainers are knowledgeable and take a genuine interest in each member's progress, providing personalized guidance and feedback. I've seen significant improvements in my overall health and fitness since joining, and I attribute that to the well-structured programs and expert coaching. The variety of classes and activities keeps workouts engaging and fun, and I appreciate the emphasis on proper technique and safety. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting out, Sicfit has something to offer. The owners and staff are passionate about helping members achieve their goals, and it shows in everything they do. If you're looking for a gym that truly cares about your well-being and success, look no further than Sicfit Scottsdale. Give it a try and experience the difference for yourself.

I'm still dreaming about that iron skillet cookie. The combination of warm, gooey cookie and cold ice cream was absolute perfection. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with the quality of food, drinks, and service. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it an excellent spot for a night out with friends or a date. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique and delicious dining experience.
"Blissful relaxation and rejuvenation, leaving me feeling refreshed and energized, with a huge smile on my face, can't wait to come back and do it all again, absolutely fantastic!"

Overall, our experience was disappointing, especially considering the high standards we've come to expect from this establishment. The buffet spread, although extensive, lacked attention to detail and freshness. The mislabeled dishes and overcooked roast beef were major turn-offs. The substitution of pumpkin for vanilla soft serve was also a puzzling decision. While the breakfast selection showed promise, the absence of simple scrambled eggs was a notable omission. With a few tweaks to address these issues, this brunch buffet could reach its full potential, but for now, it falls short of expectations.

The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was also lacking, with a decor that seemed outdated and uninviting. The background music was too loud, making it difficult to carry on a conversation. To make matters worse, the restaurant's policy of adding an automatic gratuity for parties of a certain size was not clearly stated, which could have led to an even more unpleasant surprise at the end of the meal. It's disappointing that a restaurant with such potential can be brought down by subpar service and overpriced food. The fried oyster sandwich, which was the main reason for my visit, was a letdown, and the small bun it was served on only added to the disappointment. For a restaurant that charges premium prices, you would expect a higher level of quality and attention to detail. Unfortunately, my experience fell far short of expectations. Despite the poor experience, I am willing to give the restaurant another chance, as I've heard good things about some of their other menu items. However, it will take a significant improvement in service and food quality to win me back as a customer. If the management takes steps to address the issues with their staff and menu, I would be willing to revisit and update my review. Until then, I would caution others to approach with caution and be prepared for a potentially disappointing experience.

As I reflected on our experience, I couldn't help but think about the numerous opportunities that were missed to provide excellent service. From the hostess's lack of initiative to find answers to my questions, to the prolonged wait for a greeting, it was clear that the front-of-house staff was not adequately trained. The issue with my beer glass having lipstick marks was not only unappetizing but also raised concerns about the attention to detail in the kitchen and bar area. The way our appetizer was dropped off by a food runner, still wearing gloves, without any interaction or confirmation that it was correct, was also disappointing. It seemed like the staff was more focused on expediting the service rather than ensuring that the customers' needs were met. The fact that our server was polite and attentive was a saving grace, but it wasn't enough to redeem the overall experience. What really took the cake, though, was the skimpy portion of fries in my to-go order. As a restaurant that prides itself on its endless fry baskets, it was surprising to see such a meager serving. It felt like the kitchen was trying to cut costs by skimping on the to-go orders, which is not only disappointing but also dishonest. As someone who has worked in the service industry for 7 years, I know that it's the little things that matter, and it's up to the management to ensure that their staff is trained to provide excellent service. Until then, I would caution others to think twice before dining here.

The food is consistently delicious and prepared to order. I appreciate the attention to detail and the cleanliness of the restaurant. Every visit has been a pleasant experience, and I look forward to returning. The staff's enthusiasm and dedication to customer satisfaction are truly impressive, making this Carl's Jr a standout location that I highly recommend to everyone.
The presentation was stunning, service impeccable, and each bite a masterpiece, leaving me eager to return and sample more of their innovative creations.

The nostalgic atmosphere remains intact, and the smell of sizzling burgers on the grill is still incredibly enticing. I was thrilled to see that the quality of the food has not wavered over the years. The staff is friendly and attentive, adding to the overall charm of the place. Whether you're a local or just visiting, The Chuck Box is a must-try for any burger enthusiast. The simplicity of their menu and the freshness of their ingredients make for a truly satisfying dining experience. I'll continue to recommend The Chuck Box to anyone looking for a classic burger joint in Tempe.

The lack of improvement is disappointing, and the unremarkable dishes make it hard to recommend. With numerous alternatives available, it's clear that this establishment falls short in terms of overall dining experience, making it a less desirable choice for those seeking quality food and attentive service.

The staff were friendly and attentive, adding to the welcoming atmosphere. Overall, 32 Shea has great potential and I'm excited to see how it evolves. With a few tweaks to the menu, it could become a top spot in the area. For now, it's a great addition to our neighborhood, offering a fresh and lively vibe.

Overall, it was an average experience. We might consider returning to try other menu items, but the sushi was not impressive. For the price, we expected more. Perhaps dinner service is better, but for lunch, it didn't stand out from other local options. Still, the friendly waitress and pleasant atmosphere were redeeming qualities.

Overall, I'd recommend this spot for a casual night out with friends or a low-key date. The music is usually on point, and the crowd is lively but not overly rowdy. If you're a tequila fan, you'll appreciate their extensive selection, and the prices won't break the bank. Just don't expect to be blown away by the food, and be prepared for some less-than-pristine bathroom conditions. Despite its rough edges, this place has a certain charm that keeps me coming back for more. It's a great spot to grab a drink and enjoy the Old Town scene.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel satisfied with our decision to dine at this restaurant. The combination of excellent food, stunning views, and friendly service made for a truly enjoyable experience. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable, happily answering our questions about the menu and making recommendations when needed. The atmosphere, while a bit bland if you're not seated by the window, was still upscale and refined, making it a great spot for a special occasion or romantic dinner. Despite the disappointment with the Fromage du Jour, I was impressed by the restaurant's attention to detail and commitment to using high-quality ingredients. The fettuccine Alfredo, as I mentioned earlier, was truly exceptional, and the chicken breast was cooked to perfection. I appreciated the fact that the dish was not overly salted or seasoned, allowing the natural flavors of the ingredients to shine through. One thing to note is that the restaurant can get quite busy, especially during peak hours, so it's a good idea to make a reservation in advance to ensure seating. We were lucky to get a table by the window, but I can imagine that the experience might be less enjoyable if you're stuck in a less desirable seat. Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a great dining experience in Las Vegas. While it may not be the cheapest option, the quality of the food and service make it well worth the price. And if you're a fan of fettuccine Alfredo, you owe it to yourself to try it here – it's truly a game-changer. With its excellent food, stunning views, and friendly service, this restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking to elevate their dining experience in Vegas.

The whole experience left a sour taste in my mouth, and I was disappointed that the hotel staff couldn't provide a more welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. It seemed like they were more focused on enforcing unnecessary rules rather than ensuring their guests had a good time. The fact that they claimed to be monitoring our drinks was not only intrusive but also made us feel like we were being treated like children. As someone who has stayed at numerous resorts in the Phoenix area, I can confidently say that this was one of the most unwelcoming experiences I've had. The inconsistent enforcement of their rules and the staff's attitude towards us were major turn-offs. Unfortunately, our negative experience at the hotel outweighed our previously positive experiences at the restaurants, and we will not be returning to this establishment. Overall, I would not recommend this hotel to others.

Despite the initial valet debacle, I was pleasantly surprised by the cleanliness and comfort of my room. The jet tub was a lovely touch, and the mini kitchenette was well-stocked with essentials. However, the housekeeping staff seemed to be in short supply, and I had to request extra towels and toiletries on multiple occasions. The location, as I mentioned earlier, is a major plus, with the Fashion Show mall offering a variety of dining and shopping options. The proximity to the Wynn is also a bonus, as it provides easy access to the strip without the hassle of being directly on it. One thing to note is that the hotel's amenities are somewhat limited, with no on-site casino or restaurant. However, the front desk staff were happy to provide recommendations for nearby eateries and entertainment options. Overall, my stay was decent, but the understaffing and valet issues were major drawbacks. If the hotel can address these issues, I would consider staying here again, especially given the discounted rate I was able to secure. However, at full price, I would likely opt for a more traditional hotel with a fuller range of amenities and services. With some tweaks to their staffing and operations, this hotel could be a great option for those looking for a more low-key, off-strip experience.

The staff's knowledge of the products is impressive, and they're more than happy to offer suggestions and recommendations. I ended up finding some amazing deals on packing cubes and travel-sized essentials. The overall shopping experience was seamless, and I appreciated the well-organized layout of the store. Although some items may be priced a bit higher than expected, the quality and uniqueness of the products make up for it. I've already planned my next visit to check out their seasonal collections and see what new treasures I can discover. Whether you're a neat freak or just a lover of all things organized, this store is definitely worth a visit.

The combination of delicious cuisine and stunning views made for a memorable experience. Although the service was slow, it allowed for a leisurely pace, savoring each bite and taking in the surroundings. Prices were reasonable for the quality and ambiance, making it an excellent choice for special occasions or romantic evenings in Las Vegas.

The donuts were freshly baked and the staff were friendly. Despite the issue, I was impressed by the quality and taste. I'm looking forward to trying more flavors on my next visit. Hopefully, they'll iron out the minor quality control issues to deserve that 5-star rating. Until then, I'll be back for another delicious apple fritter, hoping it's staple-free this time.

As I reflect on my numerous visits to the garden, I'm reminded of the unique experiences each season brought. The spring bloom was a personal favorite, with vibrant flowers and lush greenery transforming the landscape. Summer evenings were perfect for strolls through the garden, taking in the tranquil atmosphere and admiring the dramatic sunsets. Autumn and winter brought their own charm, with the changing foliage and holiday-themed exhibits adding a touch of magic to the already enchanting surroundings. The garden's events and programs were also noteworthy, offering something for everyone. From guided tours and workshops to concerts and festivals, there was always something new to explore. I appreciated the attention to detail and commitment to sustainability evident in every aspect of the garden's operations. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, a photographer, or simply looking for a peaceful escape, this garden is an absolute gem. Its proximity to the city makes it an ideal destination for both locals and tourists, and I highly recommend adding it to your itinerary. With its ever-changing exhibits and stunning natural beauty, you'll want to return again and again, just as I did.

I've tried giving them the benefit of the doubt multiple times, but the results are consistently underwhelming. The dash, console, and door panels often still have visible dust and dirt after the wash. It's clear that attention to detail is lacking, and the "extra" services like vacuuming and wiping down surfaces are not thoroughly done. For the price, I expect a more thorough cleaning, especially when opting for the premium package. Sadly, Danny's has become a last resort for me, and I'll be exploring other car wash options that can deliver better results and value for my money.

The lack of attention to detail and poor communication from the staff was disappointing, especially considering it wasn't even busy. The food, although tasty, couldn't make up for the subpar service. It's unfortunate that a simple request like coffee became a frustrating ordeal. The eye-rolling and dismissive attitude from the lady at the counter was the final straw. As a customer, it's reasonable to expect a certain level of service, especially when it comes to basic requests. Unfortunately, this location has consistently fallen short, and it's clear that we won't be returning anytime soon. Maybe it's time for them to reevaluate their service standards.

In retrospect, our experience at The Hard Rock was a mixed bag, with some positives overshadowed by the numerous negatives. The $100 per night deposit, which was not clearly disclosed at the time of booking, was a significant inconvenience. It's understandable that the hotel wants to protect itself from rowdy guests, but it would be reasonable to expect some transparency about this policy. The construction noise was another major issue, and it's astonishing that the workers thought it was acceptable to start making noise at 5 am. The fact that we had to yell down at them to stop is a testament to the hotel's lack of consideration for its guests. The additional charge for using the gym is also a bit steep, especially considering the already high prices of the rooms. Our dining experience at Mr. Lucky's was also marred by the unpleasant incident with the vomiting guest. While it's not the hotel's fault that some guests can't handle their liquor, it's still worth the hotel's attention to improve their overall guest experience. On the other hand, the Pink Taco was a pleasant surprise, and we would highly recommend it to anyone looking for good food. The presence of a CVS pharmacy across the street was also a lifesaver, as it allowed us to purchase beer at a fraction of the cost of the hotel's prices. This is definitely something to keep in mind for future guests who want to enjoy a few drinks without breaking the bank. Overall, while The Hard Rock has some redeeming qualities, its numerous drawbacks make it a less-than-ideal choice for anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Unless you're a party animal who doesn't mind the chaos and noise, it's probably best to look elsewhere.

The quality of the food was not enough to make up for the poor service we experienced. Our entrees were just okay, nothing special, and the long wait had taken away our appetite. The atmosphere of the restaurant was nice, but the slow service and mistakes made by the waiter overshadowed everything. It's disappointing to see a restaurant that was once a favorite of ours decline in quality. The lack of attention to detail and poor communication between the staff is unacceptable. Overall, our recent experiences at Crust have been disappointing, and we will not be returning anytime soon.

The rest of our stay was uneventful, but the initial impression had already been made. The tower rooms were nice, I'll give them that, but it was too little, too late. The hotel's attempt to rectify the situation by moving us to our originally booked rooms was appreciated, but the damage had already been done. The lack of attention to detail and poor customer service left a sour taste in my mouth. The fact that our rooms were not ready at check-in, and the excuses provided by the manager, only added to the frustration. It's disappointing to see a hotel of this caliber drop the ball so severely. The CES conference was a huge success, but my stay at this hotel was a major failure. I will be taking my business (and my attendees) elsewhere for future events. The hotel needs to seriously revamp its customer service and room allocation process to prevent similar disasters from happening in the future. Until then, I will be advising colleagues and friends to avoid this place at all costs. One star from me, and that's being generous.

Overall, I highly recommend Baja Joe's for their delicious dishes, particularly the outstanding ceviche. However, be prepared for a potentially overwhelming atmosphere due to the loud music. To fully enjoy your meal, consider calling ahead to confirm the entertainment schedule. Despite this, the exceptional food makes it a worthwhile visit, and I will continue to return for their fantastic cuisine.

Overall, my experience was a letdown due to the high prices and inconsistent quality. While the bake shop's treats are a highlight, the main restaurant's dishes fell short of my expectations. With better options available in town, I wouldn't recommend dining here unless they reassess their pricing and refine their culinary offerings to match the excellence of their baked goods. Perhaps with some changes, they can live up to their full potential.

The portion size was decent, but the flavors just didn't pop. I've had better pho at other establishments in the area, and for the price, I expected more. The service was friendly, but our server seemed overwhelmed, taking a while to take our order and forgetting one of our appetizers. Overall, while this place might be a convenient alternative to Pho Kim Long, it's not worth going out of your way for. If you're craving authentic, delicious Vietnamese cuisine, you might want to look elsewhere or wait it out for Pho Kim Long. Unfortunately, this spot just didn't live up to my expectations.

The atmosphere was lively and family-friendly, making it an excellent choice for our evening out. The prices were reasonable, and the portion sizes were generous. Our server was attentive and ensured that our glasses were always full. The combination of delicious food, exceptional service, and pleasant ambiance has earned Golden Buddha a spot on our list of favorite restaurants. We can't wait to go back and try more of their dishes, and we highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great dining experience.

Overall, the quality of the dishes made up for the inconsistencies in service. Despite the confusing moments, our server was friendly and tried their best. With some improvements to their service, this place could truly shine, and I'm willing to give it another chance to see if sitting downstairs makes a difference.

The staff were friendly, efficient, and did an excellent job. They kept me updated on the progress and even called when it was ready. Their prices were very reasonable and I'm so grateful for their help. I highly recommend this place for any luggage repair needs, they truly saved my trip.

However, considering the price, I expected more. The flavors were unique and enjoyable, making it a worthwhile try for vegan dessert enthusiasts, but improvements in portion size would enhance the overall value and experience.

We had to flag down another staff member to request the check, which was a bit frustrating. Despite the issues with service, our waiter was friendly when he was present, and the food arrived in a timely manner. The prices were reasonable, with most pasta dishes falling in the $15-$20 range. Overall, La Cucina Flegrea has potential, but it needs to work on its ambiance and service to elevate the dining experience. With a few tweaks, this could be a great spot for a pre-theater dinner or a casual night out. As it stands, I would recommend it to fans of Italian cuisine who are looking for a no-frills meal, but may not be the best choice for those seeking a more polished experience. Perhaps with some updates to the interior and improvements to the service, La Cucina Flegrea could become a top destination in the area. For now, it's an average option that could be worth a try.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot to catch up with friends or get some work done. The prices were reasonable, and the portion sizes were generous. I appreciated the attention to detail, from the flavors in my drink to the freshness of the muffin. Overall, I'm so glad I stopped by and I'll definitely be back to try more of their menu items. The combination of excellent service, tasty treats, and stunning views makes this coffee shop a must-visit destination for anyone in the area. I'm already looking forward to my next visit.

I've visited this shop a handful of times, and while the inventory can be hit-or-miss, I've managed to find some hidden gems. The prices are generally fair, and the staff is always willing to negotiate. It's clear that they're not trying to be a high-end pawn shop, but rather a community-driven store where people can find decent deals on everyday items. If you're looking for a unique shopping experience and aren't expecting to find rare treasures, this place is worth a visit. Just be prepared to dig through the shelves and showcases to find something that catches your eye. Overall, it's a charming little shop with a lot of character, and I'll likely continue to stop by whenever I'm in the area.

However, despite the language barrier, the staff is always willing to help and ensure that you have a pleasant dining experience. The atmosphere is casual and cozy, with a few tables and chairs scattered around the small dining area. It's not fancy, but it's comfortable and inviting. One thing to note is that the menu can be a bit overwhelming, especially if you're not familiar with Persian cuisine. But don't worry, the staff will do their best to guide you through the options and help you make a decision. And if you're feeling adventurous, you can always ask for recommendations. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. We've never spent more than $20 per person, and that includes a kabob, side dishes, and drinks. Overall, I would highly recommend Khaneh Kabob (or Kabob House, as I still like to call it) to anyone looking for delicious, authentic Persian cuisine at a great price. Just be patient with the service, and don't be afraid to ask for help navigating the menu. With its unique flavors and generous portions, this hidden gem is sure to become a favorite among foodies and families alike.

As I sat there, trying to enjoy my overpriced meal, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and frustration. The atmosphere, which initially seemed intriguing with its unique blend of Chinese and Western decor, quickly fell flat due to the cold and unfriendly service. The fishtanks at the entrance, which I thought would be a nice touch, ended up feeling like a gimmick, a desperate attempt to distract from the subpar experience. The food, while authentic in taste, was not enough to justify the exorbitant prices. The spicy wonton was good, but not exceptional, and the beef noodles were nothing special. The small portion of fried rice was a joke, especially considering the price we paid. I've had better, more generous servings at a fraction of the cost at other Chinese restaurants in the city. What really took the cake, though, was the abrupt and rude service. The waiter's curt question of "Finish?" mid-meal was the final straw. It was as if they were eager to get us out of there, rather than providing us with a pleasant dining experience. Needless to say, I will not be returning to Beijing Noodle No. 9 anytime soon. If you're looking for a good meal at a reasonable price, I would highly recommend avoiding this overpriced and underwhelming restaurant. Instead, take my advice and head to the Bachannal Buffet, where you can get a delicious and filling meal without breaking the bank. Trust me, your wallet (and your taste buds) will thank you.

As I reflect on our exceptional dining experience at Greenbush, I am reminded of the importance of ambiance in enhancing the overall culinary journey. The dimly lit interior, complete with rustic wooden accents and vintage decor, seamlessly transports patrons to a cozy, intimate setting that is perfect for a night out with friends or a romantic evening. The staff, too, were attentive and knowledgeable, happy to offer recommendations and share the story behind the restaurant's commitment to using locally sourced ingredients. What truly sets Greenbush apart, however, is its unwavering dedication to quality and craftsmanship. From the carefully curated wine list to the expertly prepared pizzas, every aspect of the dining experience exudes a sense of thoughtfulness and attention to detail. The fact that the restaurant is able to maintain such high standards while still offering a welcoming, unpretentious atmosphere is a testament to the passion and expertise of the team behind Greenbush. As a self-proclaimed pizza connoisseur, I can confidently say that Greenbush has earned a spot among my top recommendations. Whether you're a fellow Midwesterner or just visiting the area, this hidden gem is an absolute must-visit for anyone looking to experience the best of Madison's culinary scene. So, do yourself a favor and stop by Greenbush – I promise you won't be disappointed. And who knows, you might just find yourself, like me, concocting excuses to return and indulge in another unforgettable meal. With its unbeatable combination of delicious food, cozy atmosphere, and exceptional service, Greenbush is sure to leave a lasting impression on even the most discerning diners.
for providing reliable and affordable rides, keeping our community safe with trusted drivers like John, and constantly improving your services with innovative technology.

I've had the chance to explore different parts of the city without worrying about parking or traffic, which is a huge plus. The routes may not be the most direct, but they cover a significant amount of ground, and I've discovered some new neighborhoods and attractions that I wouldn't have otherwise visited. While the wait times can be frustrating, I've learned to plan ahead and use the time to catch up on reading or listen to music. The affordability and convenience of the Port Authority buses make them an excellent option for casual, non-time-sensitive travel. Overall, I appreciate the service they provide and the freedom it gives me to leave my car behind, even if it's just for a day of running errands or meeting friends. It's not perfect, but it's a valuable resource for our city.
Terrible experience, extremely disappointing, and utterly frustrating, a complete waste of time and money, will not recommend to anyone.

The Good: I could state a few mediocre points, such as that the office was clean, but they aren't really of any great import. The Bad: The doctor only addressed part of my concerns, as I was very interested in seeking help on 2 different-but-related medical issues. Most of his focus was on one issue, with the other being set aside for another time. Though the first visit wasn't rushed, the second appointment did not feel the same. The doctor seemed eager to use scare tactics during our two conversations, focusing on the possible lethality of a condition, ignoring questions of severity or likelihood. He comes across as patronizing behind a slightly jovial veneer and attempting to scare someone as part of pushing a treatment plan is unprofessional in the extreme. The doctor suggested I obtain a basic blood test, which could be done via a blood draw at his office. I asked how much the testing would cost (I don't have insurance yet) and was told it would be between $100-200. The doctor was horribly wrong, as the bill was slightly under $500. Though his office did pay part of the bill and help reduce the total cost to me (after I complained), I still paid over $150 more than I had been led to expect. The Ugly: During my first visit to the office I handed the receptionist my driver's license to be photocopied. It wasn't until 3pm the next afternoon that I realized she'd never given it back to me. When I called back to see if I'd left it there her response was, "Oh yes! We have it right here for you in the desk drawer." Glad it wasn't lost, but if you'd had my card sitting around all day and you HAVE MY PHONE NUMBER, I believe a call back to me would be in order. In summary Dr. Marks is not a bad guy, but is not a doctor I intend on seeing again. I would not recommend him for your use as a general practice DO. As I reflect on my experience with Dr. Marks, I am reminded of the importance of finding a doctor who is not only knowledgeable but also genuinely cares about their patients' well-being. Unfortunately, my interactions with Dr. Marks left me feeling like just another number, rather than an individual with unique concerns and needs. The fact that he relied on scare tactics to push a treatment plan, rather than taking the time to address my questions and concerns, was particularly troubling. Furthermore, the discrepancy in the cost of the blood test was not only frustrating but also financially burdensome. As someone without insurance, I had to be mindful of every dollar I spent, and the unexpected expense was a significant blow. While the office did eventually help to reduce the cost, the initial mistake and lack of transparency were inexcusable. The incident with my driver's license, although seemingly minor, was also telling. The fact that the receptionist didn't bother to call me to return my identification, despite having my phone number, speaks to a lack of attention to detail and respect for patients' time. It's the little things like this that can make a big difference in the overall quality of care and patient experience. In conclusion, while Dr. Marks may have his strengths, my experience with him was overwhelmingly negative. I would caution others to approach his practice with skepticism and to carefully consider their options before seeking his care. With so many qualified and compassionate doctors out there, I believe that patients deserve better than a practitioner who prioritizes scare tactics and profit over patient-centered care.

As I sat there, nursing my wounds and trying to catch my breath, I couldn't help but think about how easily this accident could have been prevented. A simple caution sign or a non-slip mat would have made all the difference. The fact that the staff seemed to be aware of the issue, yet failed to take any action, is appalling. I was lucky to have escaped with just a bruise and some pain, but what if someone else isn't so fortunate? The Cosmo's negligence could lead to a serious lawsuit, and it's only a matter of time before someone gets seriously hurt. I've always loved the Cosmo for its trendy vibe and luxurious amenities, but this experience has left a sour taste in my mouth. The lack of attention to safety and guest well-being is unacceptable, especially considering the high prices they charge for their rooms and services. I hope that the management takes my complaint seriously and takes immediate action to address this issue. In the meantime, I would advise other guests to be extremely cautious when walking around the pool area, especially if they're barefoot or have kids with them. It's a shame that such a great hotel can be so careless about the safety of its guests. I'll be thinking twice before booking another stay at the Cosmo, and I hope that they can regain my trust by taking steps to prevent accidents like this from happening in the future.
Overall, a disappointing experience with subpar amenities and unfriendly service, making it not worth the stay.

As I reflect on our experience with the Western Journey Tour, I have to say that I'm still disappointed with the overall value we received. While the helicopter ride was undoubtedly the highlight of the tour, it felt like a tease, leaving us wanting more. The rest of the tour, which made up the bulk of the time, was underwhelming and felt like a series of overpriced, touristy attractions. The skywalk at Eagle Point, for example, was a unique experience, but the restrictions on taking our own cameras and the exorbitant prices for the official photos were a major turn-off. It felt like they were nickel-and-diming us at every turn, which took away from the enjoyment of the experience. And the Native American village, which I was expecting to be a fascinating cultural experience, was little more than a few token teepees and a gift shop. Guano Point was probably the most enjoyable part of the tour, aside from the helicopter ride. The views were stunning, and we appreciated the opportunity to hike up to the point and take in the scenery. However, the food was a major letdown. I wasn't expecting a gourmet meal, but the quality of the food was subpar, and it felt like an afterthought. The fact that we didn't even have time to visit the Hualapai Ranch, which was supposedly part of the tour, was a major disappointment. It felt like we were being rushed through the experience, without any regard for the actual activities and attractions that were supposed to be included. One of the biggest issues I have with this tour is the false advertising. The tour is advertised as a 7-hour experience, but we were done in under 5 hours. The pickup and drop-off times were also misleading, as we spent a significant amount of time waiting around at the airport. And the flight back, which I was expecting to be a scenic tour of the canyon, was essentially a repeat of the same views we had seen on the way out. Overall, I would not recommend the Western Journey Tour to anyone. While the helicopter ride was amazing, the rest of the tour was a series of overpriced, underwhelming experiences. If you're looking for a truly memorable experience in the Grand Canyon, I would suggest looking into other tour options that actually deliver on their promises. In this case, the Western Journey Tour felt like a waste of money, and I would caution others against making the same mistake. In hindsight, I wish we had done more research and read more reviews before booking this tour. It's clear that many others have had similar experiences, and it's disappointing that the tour operator hasn't taken steps to address these issues. If you're considering booking the Western Journey Tour, I would urge you to think twice and explore other options. With so many amazing experiences to be had in the Grand Canyon, it's a shame to settle for a subpar tour that fails to deliver on its promises.

I'm extremely disappointed in the drastic change in the staff's behavior and priorities. It's appalling that they're more focused on making a profit than providing genuine care and attention to the pets. The fact that they refused to let me speak with Dr. Ron, even for a minute, is unacceptable. As a pet owner, it's frustrating to feel like I'm being taken advantage of, especially when I'm already struggling to make ends meet. The experience with my Labrador's infection abscess was a clear indication of the staff's incompetence. The female doctor's misdiagnosis and attempt to push unnecessary tests and medications was not only unprofessional but also costly. Thankfully, Dr. Ron intervened and prescribed the correct treatment, which worked wonders for my dog. Now, with my Rottie's new issue, I'm anxious to get her the proper care without being ripped off. All I need is a simple urine test, but the staff's reluctance to communicate with me or relay my messages to Dr. Ron is hindering the process. It's sad to see a once-caring and compassionate team turn into a money-driven machine. I implore the management to re-evaluate their staff's training and priorities, as it's clear that they've lost sight of what truly matters – the well-being of the animals. Until then, I'll continue to advocate for my pets and seek Dr. Ron's expertise, while avoiding the unprofessional and greedy staff.

I'm not even exaggerating when I say that I've had more pleasant experiences at the dentist's office. At least there, I know I'm going to be in pain, but it's a quick and necessary kind of pain. This post office, on the other hand, is a slow and agonizing kind of torture that leaves you wondering why you even bothered getting out of bed that morning. The lines are always ridiculously long, and the employees seem to be competing in some sort of bizarre, sadistic contest to see who can move the slowest. And don't even get me started on the "organization" of the place. It's like they took every bad idea from every other post office, threw them all into a blender, and hit puree. The layout is confusing, the signs are unclear, and the whole atmosphere is just chaotic. I've seen people wander around in circles, trying to figure out where to go or what to do, while the employees just sit there, watching them with a mixture of disdain and boredom. I've tried to give this post office the benefit of the doubt, I really have. I've gone in at different times of day, thinking that maybe it's just busy during certain hours. But no, it's always the same. The employees are always slow, the lines are always long, and the whole experience is always a nightmare. I've even tried to be friendly and courteous, thinking that maybe if I'm nice to them, they'll be nice to me. But no, it doesn't seem to matter. They're always surly, always unfriendly, and always seem to be looking for ways to make my experience worse. If I could give this post office a zero-star review, I would. In fact, I'd give it a negative-star review if that were possible. It's a waste of time, a waste of energy, and a waste of space. If you value your sanity, stay far, far away from this place. Go to one of the other post offices in the area, like the ones on St. Rose or Horizon Ridge. They're not perfect, but they're infinitely better than this dump. Or, you know, just use carrier pigeons. At least they're reliable.

The server was amazing! Through out the meal his was very helpful and friendly..... but that doesn't make up for the awful food! Ambiance doesn't make up for the disgusting food. The food is so bad..... it makes it over priced. We started off with veggie dumplings. Let me just say, Trader Joe's makes better dumplings! The we got an tuna wasabi appetizer. The pieces were so big, we could barely fit them in our mouth! We also got another roll that was cut into large pieces. It comes down to this, I don't mind spend money on a good meal! What a waste of money! Don't go!!!!! Overall, my experience was extremely disappointing. I expected much better quality and presentation from this establishment. Unfortunately, the subpar food and oversized portions overshadowed the excellent service. Unless they revamp their menu and cooking techniques, I would strongly advise against dining here. Save your money and opt for a better culinary experience elsewhere. One star from me, and that's being generous.

The quality of the sushi and happy hour deals are definitely worth returning for. However, the poor service from the bartender was a major letdown. Despite this, we enjoyed our meal and would recommend the poppers and other dishes, hoping that the service improves on future visits.

Wanted check out this new spot. Support local business. Service was a little slow but nice. I was debating on a rice dish, but had to do Pho because it's in their name. I got #P1. For the Large size, there wasn't enough meat or noodles, there was more than enough soup though. The Pho itself was avg, you're not going to hate it, it is what it is. Granted Im 5'10 170lbs and just got done working out, but I'm leaving the restaurant hungry and going to find another meal. For $10 just for the special and no drink..... Just not worth my time If other reviewers like it, that's great, but I wouldn't recommend this spot to anyone. Unfortunately, my experience was underwhelming, and I left feeling disappointed. The value for the price was not there, and I expected more from a place with'Pho' in its name. Perhaps they'll improve with time, but for now, I'll be taking my business elsewhere. Overall, a subpar dining experience that failed to impress.

The friendly staff and efficient checkout process made my shopping experience even more pleasant. I was able to quickly find everything I needed and get back to my temporary accommodation. Overall, I'm impressed with this Target location and appreciate the convenience it provided during my unexpected extended stay in Phoenix. The store's organization and amenities exceeded my expectations.

I'm extremely disappointed in not only the product, but also the response from the owner, Johnathan. As a customer, I expect a certain level of quality and service, and this place fell short on both accounts. The fact that the owner would resort to hostile comments instead of taking constructive feedback is alarming. It's clear that they are more concerned with defending their ego than with providing a good experience for their customers. I will definitely be sharing my negative experience with friends, family, and online communities, and I would advise others to think twice before visiting this establishment. The lack of flavor and unappetizing texture of their Nutella ice cream was bad enough, but the owner's behavior has ensured that I will never be back.

The atmosphere is always lively and welcoming, making it an ideal spot to catch up with friends or meet new people. The staff is friendly and attentive, ensuring that your glasses are always full. The variety of games and activities keeps things entertaining, and the affordable prices make it a great value. Whether you're a local or just visiting, Brewski's is a must-visit destination in Pittsburgh. With its unique motto and relaxed vibe, it's the perfect place to unwind and have a great time. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fun night out.

The crowd was a mix of wannabe socialites and people trying too hard to fit in, all gathered around the bar, ordering overpriced drinks and pretending to have the time of their lives. The music was loud, but it was just a generic playlist that could be found at any other club. I didn't see anything unique or special about this place that would justify the hefty cover charge and outrageous drink prices. The pool area was nice, I'll give them that, but it was crowded and felt more like a tourist trap than a luxurious oasis. As I looked around, I noticed that everyone was more concerned with taking selfies and showing off their fake smiles than actually enjoying themselves. It was like they were all trying to prove something to someone, but I'm not sure who. The vibe was superficial and lacking in any real substance. I've been to plenty of other clubs that had a more genuine and lively atmosphere, where people were actually there to have fun and connect with others, not just to be seen. Overall, my experience at Surrender was underwhelming and felt like a waste of money. Unless you're into the whole pretentious scene and don't mind throwing your cash around, I'd recommend looking elsewhere for a more authentic and enjoyable nightlife experience. With so many other great options out there, I wouldn't bother coming back to this place again. The whole experience left a bad taste in my mouth, and I'm glad to be done with it.

The unique burger option showcases the Dane's creative twist on classic pub fare. Overall, it's a solid choice for a casual night out with friends or a low-key dinner. While it may not be perfect, the Dane's charm and offerings make it a worthwhile stop when in the area, earning its four-star rating with ease and consistency.

I've been coming back to Echo regularly and have yet to be disappointed. The consistency in their coffee and service is impressive, and I appreciate the attention to detail they bring to every drink. The atmosphere remains cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot for studying, working, or simply catching up with friends. I've also noticed that they often have local art on display, which adds a nice touch to the overall ambiance. Overall, Echo has become my go-to coffee shop, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming and productive space to hang out.

As I reflected on my experience, I couldn't help but think that the restaurant's potential was hindered by a series of minor mishaps. The food, when it was correctly prepared and presented, was indeed superb. The filet was cooked to perfection, and the flavors of the garlic-onion mashed potatoes and Port syrup complemented it beautifully. The grilled asparagus was a nice touch, and I appreciated the effort to incorporate seasonal ingredients into the dish. However, the inconsistencies in service and attention to detail were glaring. From the initial lack of acknowledgement at the podium to the confusion over the Groupon and the missing ingredients, it seemed like the restaurant was struggling to get its act together. The charge for a partial refill of iced tea seemed petty, and the fact that they were out of bananas for the dessert was a significant disappointment. I also couldn't help but wonder about the communication breakdown between the staff. The woman who seated me seemed unsure about the Groupon policy, and the manager's request to copy my ID seemed unnecessary and overly cautious. The fact that the kitchen was missing key ingredients, such as the crispy tater strings and bananas, suggested a lack of planning and preparation. Despite these issues, I did appreciate the effort that the restaurant put into plating and presentation. The dishes looked appealing, and the use of garnishes and sauces added a touch of elegance to the meal.
