However, the overall experience was marred by the accumulation of little things that went wrong. As I finished my meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel that Addiction had missed an opportunity to impress. With a bit more attention to detail and a more streamlined service, this restaurant could easily earn the 4 or 4.5 stars that it aspires to. As it stands, however, the little things that went wrong added up to a significant subtraction in my enjoyment of the meal. I'm not sure if I'll give Addiction another chance, but I hope that they take my feedback to heart and work to address the issues that detracted from my experience. With a bit of tweaking, this restaurant could truly live up to its potential and provide a memorable dining experience for its customers.

As the night wore on, our frustration and disappointment only grew. The lack of attention to detail and poor service was staggering, especially considering the high prices we were paying. It seemed like the staff was overwhelmed and understaffed, which led to a chaotic and disorganized dining experience. The fact that we had to repeatedly ask for basic items like utensils and water was unacceptable. The food, aside from the lamb chops, was a letdown. The steak, as I mentioned, was ridiculously undercooked, and the other dishes were just average. The family-style service, which we had agreed to, ended up being a disaster. The portions were unevenly distributed, and it seemed like the staff was more interested in pushing the expensive meats than in ensuring that everyone had a pleasant dining experience. The noise level was also a major issue. The restaurant was so loud that we had to shout to be heard, which made it difficult to carry on conversations. The tight seating arrangement didn't help, and my husband's repeated collisions with the waiters were a testament to the cramped quarters. Given the exorbitant prices and the promises of a high-end dining experience, we expected much more from this restaurant. Unfortunately, our experience was a resounding disappointment. The $2100 bill, which included a 20% tip, was a bitter pill to swallow, especially considering the subpar service and food. As we left the restaurant after a lengthy three hours, we couldn't help but feel that we had been ripped off. The memory of that disastrous dinner party will linger, and we will definitely not be returning to this establishment anytime soon.
Our server seemed completely disinterested, and the manager was nowhere to be found to address our concerns, making the experience even more disappointing and overpriced.

Overall, we were thoroughly impressed with the laid-back atmosphere and excellent service at this hidden gem. The fact that they took the bread pudding off our bill without us even asking was a testament to their commitment to customer satisfaction. We appreciated the attention to detail in their menu items, such as the unique twist on the mac'n cheese. The prices were also very reasonable, especially during happy hour. We would definitely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a relaxed and welcoming place to grab a drink and some good food. The casual dress code and abundance of seating made it feel like a great spot to meet up with friends or catch a sports game. We're already planning our next visit to escape the Scottsdale heat and enjoy some more of their tasty treats.

Overall, my experience at Cien Agaves has been a mixed bag, but I can appreciate their strengths. The tequila selection is undoubtedly one of the highlights, with an impressive array of options to choose from. The margaritas, as I mentioned earlier, are also a standout, packing a punch and making for a great accompaniment to their Taco Tuesday offerings. However, the food, while not terrible, fails to impress. The shredded beef tacos, although a bargain at a dollar apiece, lack a certain depth of flavor and texture that would elevate them to the next level. It's clear that the kitchen is capable of producing decent, if unremarkable, dishes, but they don't quite live up to the standards set by the bar. Despite the occasional live music and the undeniable charm of a quiet, upscale atmosphere, Cien Agaves struggles to draw a crowd outside of their weekly Taco Tuesday specials. Perhaps this is due in part to the lack of a patio, which seems to be a major draw for many of their competitors. Whatever the reason, it's a shame, as the bar itself has a certain appeal that's worth exploring. If you're a tequila enthusiast or just looking for a low-key spot to grab a drink, Cien Agaves might be worth a visit – just don't expect to be blown away by the food.

I was disappointed by the misrepresentation, as a traditional rarebit is a beloved British dish. The tortilla dish, while tasty, did not resemble rarebit in any way. I appreciate creativity, but not at the expense of accuracy. It's a shame, as the restaurant has potential, but this experience left a sour taste. I hope they revisit their menu to better reflect the dishes they serve, especially when using names that evoke strong cultural associations.

The atmosphere was lively, yet intimate, making it perfect for a date or a special occasion. The background music was subtle, allowing for easy conversation, and the lighting was dimmed just enough to create a romantic ambiance. Our server, although a bit overzealous with the check-ins, was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, making excellent recommendations. The food, as I mentioned earlier, was delicious and plentiful. The lasagna was cooked to perfection, with layers of tender pasta, rich meat sauce, and a blend of creamy cheeses. My date's chicken parmesan was also a hit, with a crispy exterior giving way to juicy, flavorful chicken. We both left feeling satisfied, but not overly stuffed, which was a nice change of pace from the typical heavy, indulgent meals often found at Italian restaurants. Despite the few quirks with the service, our overall experience at Nick's was exceptional. The combination of great food, elegant atmosphere, and attentive (if slightly humorous) service made for a wonderful afternoon out. I would highly recommend Nick's to anyone looking for a nice spot to take a date, celebrate a special occasion, or simply enjoy a delicious meal in a sophisticated setting. With multiple locations throughout the valley, it's convenient to find one near you. I'm already looking forward to my next visit and exploring more of their extensive menu. Whether you're a foodie, a romantic, or just someone who appreciates a great dining experience, Nick's is definitely worth checking out.

The overall atmosphere felt dated and uninviting, with a clear lack of attention to detail. For a restaurant of this caliber, it's unacceptable to have subpar service and hit-or-miss dishes. The fact that we had to repeatedly ask for refills and wait extended periods for our orders to be fulfilled was frustrating. The valet experience was also a nuisance, and the added fee felt like an unnecessary insult. Given the high prices, I expected a much more refined and enjoyable experience. Unfortunately, this establishment fell far short of my expectations, and I would not recommend it to others. The comparison to Outback is apt, as I've had better meals and service at a fraction of the cost.

Despite the issues with the grilled shrimp salad and the service, I can appreciate the effort that the staff puts into making everything to order. The kitchen may be unorganized, but it's clear that they're trying to provide a homemade touch to their dishes. The no-frills location and Styrofoam boxes may not be the most appealing, but it's a small price to pay for the affordability and flavor of the grilled fish and mac and cheese. However, the issue at the register is a major concern that needs to be addressed. In today's digital age, it's unacceptable to have a payment system that requires customers to read out their sensitive information loud. This is not only a violation of privacy but also a significant security risk. I hope that the management takes steps to update their payment system and train their staff on how to handle sensitive information securely. Overall, I would recommend this place to those who are looking for a quick and affordable bite, but with the caveat that they should stick to the grilled fish and mac and cheese. The inconsistent quality and service issues hold me back from giving a full endorsement, but I appreciate the effort and potential that this place has. With some improvements to their payment system and kitchen efficiency, this place could be a hidden gem. For now, it's a solid option for a budget-friendly meal, but be aware of the potential drawbacks.

"However, some menu items fall short. With a few tweaks, this place could truly shine, as the waffle sandwich and cheesecake showcase their potential for excellence, leaving me hopeful for future improvements."
Great for families or a quick bite, the atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it an excellent choice for any pizza lover seeking a satisfying meal.

The combination of a lively atmosphere and proximity to public transportation makes Maizie's an ideal spot for a low-key gathering. Although the noise level inside can be overwhelming, the outdoor patio provides a pleasant alternative for those seeking a more subdued experience. With its satisfying food options and convenient location, Maizie's has the potential to become a regular haunt for those in the area. To take it to the next level, the establishment could focus on refining its service, perhaps by providing more attentive and friendly staff to enhance the overall dining experience. Despite some minor drawbacks, Maizie's remains a solid choice for a casual, weekday hangout.

As I delved deeper into the variety of donuts, I found myself appreciating the presentation and creativity that went into each piece. The attention to detail and the effort to create unique flavor combinations were evident, but unfortunately, the execution fell short. I think with a bit more refinement and balance in the flavors, this donut shop could truly stand out from the rest. For now, I would recommend it to those looking to impress their friends or colleagues with visually stunning treats, but not necessarily for those seeking a truly exceptional donut experience. The prices were reasonable, considering the complexity of the designs and the generous serving sizes. However, I do think that the quality of the ingredients could be improved to elevate the overall taste and texture of the donuts. Perhaps with some tweaking of the recipes and a focus on using higher-quality ingredients, this donut shop could reach its full potential. Until then, I would suggest visiting for the novelty and creativity, but not necessarily for a satisfying donut fix. With a bit more work on the flavor profiles, I could see this shop becoming a top destination for donut enthusiasts, but for now, it's more of a fun and quirky spot to grab a unique treat.

As I walked through the sliding glass doors, I was immediately impressed by the modern and sleek interior design. The wide aisles and well-organized shelves made it easy to navigate and find what I was looking for. The fresh food section was a game-changer, with a vast selection of fruits, vegetables, meats, and baked goods that rivaled any traditional grocery store. I was pleased to see that the prices were competitive with other stores in the area, making it a great option for weekly grocery shopping. The addition of a new Pharmacy, Photo, Starbucks, and Target Cafe with Pizza Hut Express was a nice touch, providing a one-stop shopping experience. I was able to grab a coffee and snack while I shopped, and the Pizza Hut Express was a great option for a quick and easy meal. The staff was friendly and helpful, eager to answer any questions I had about the store or its products. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with this new Target Store and its expanded food format. It's a great addition to the community, and I'm excited to make it my go-to destination for groceries and other essentials. With its convenient location and ample parking, I'm sure it will become a popular spot for locals and visitors alike.

The food at TaTa Bistro is a highlight, with a wide range of options to suit different cravings. I've tried their sushi and teppanyaki dishes, and both were cooked to perfection. The portion sizes are generous, and the flavors are well-balanced. The "lunch box" specials are a great value, offering a combination of dishes at an affordable price. While the slow service can be a drawback, the friendly staff makes up for it. Overall, TaTa Bistro is a great spot for a casual meal with friends or coworkers. The relaxed atmosphere and varied menu make it an excellent choice for a low-key dining experience. With its affordable prices and tasty food, I would definitely recommend TaTa Bistro for a quick and satisfying meal.

I was shocked and appalled by the door guy's behavior, and the fact that he felt entitled to use physical force against me simply because I made a joke about the situation. As a customer, I expect to be treated with respect and dignity, regardless of any mistakes I may have made. The fact that the establishment employs someone who thinks it's acceptable to push a small, intoxicated woman around is deeply disturbing. The owner of the nearby shop who intervened was kind and apologetic, but it was clear that he was also shocked by the door guy's behavior. I'm extremely disappointed in the way I was treated, and I will not be returning to this establishment again. In fact, I will be making sure to tell all my friends and family about the horrible experience I had, and I hope that the management will take steps to address this issue and ensure that their customers are treated with the respect they deserve. The food may have been good in the past, but it's not worth risking my safety and well-being to eat there again.

Overall, our experience at this Tapas restaurant was exceptional. The combination of delicious food, excellent service, and cozy ambiance made for a fantastic evening out. The staff's attention to detail and willingness to go above and beyond, such as lending us a charger, really made us feel valued as customers. The prices were also very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the dishes. We would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a fun and lively spot to grab a bite before a night out. Whether you're with a group of friends or on a date, this Tapas restaurant is sure to impress. We can't wait to come back and try more of their tasty dishes! The atmosphere is lively and fun, making it an ideal spot to start your night out.

The atmosphere is always lively, and the staff remembers my order every time. The TLT is a game-changer, and the bacon adds a smoky flavor. Leaving the skin on the trout is a must-try for any trout lover. Overall, it's a fantastic spot to unwind after a round of golf, with great food and welcoming regulars.

The bartenders were friendly and knowledgeable, crafting classic cocktails with ease. Although it was crowded, the vibe remained lively and welcoming. I was thrilled to see the jukebox still spinning great tunes, adding to the nostalgic charm. Overall, The Squirrel Cage remains a San Francisco staple, and I'm already looking forward to my next visit to relive old memories and create new ones.

The scenery is beautiful, with a mix of wooded areas and open fields. Wildlife is abundant, and it's not uncommon to see deer or turkeys during your visit. The park is well-maintained, with clear signage and amenities like restrooms and water fountains. Overall, I highly recommend this park to outdoor enthusiasts looking for a challenging and scenic escape from the city. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting out, there's something for everyone in this incredible urban oasis.
The unique flavors were intriguing, but overall, the experience was just average, lacking the wow factor to justify the high prices and make me want to return for another visit anytime soon.

and I would not recommend it to anyone. The service was also subpar, with our waitress seeming completely unbothered by our complaints. The fact that she tried to pass off the overcooked appetizer as normal is a clear indication of the lack of training and attention to detail in the kitchen. For a restaurant chain that typically delivers high-quality seafood, this location is a major disappointment. The small, watery crab legs were the final nail in the coffin, leaving a bad taste in my mouth. Needless to say, I will be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner, the staff is attentive and prices are reasonable, making it an excellent spot to relax and enjoy a tasty meal in a cozy setting, highly recommended for its overall value and quality.

Overall, I'd say this post office gets the job done, but don't expect a warm welcome. The similarity to our hometown post office was amusing, but the lackluster service was a letdown. Perhaps it was just an off day, but I wouldn't go out of my way to recommend this location for its customer experience. Nonetheless, it's a functional stop for shipping needs, and the quick in-and-out was a plus.

"Always a pleasure to dine here, friendly staff and great value. Highly recommend for a delicious breakfast or brunch option, convenient location and ample parking make it an ideal choice for those visiting the strip."

As the seminar came to an abrupt end, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and frustrated with the lack of attention and expertise provided by the trainer. Despite being the only participant, I felt like I was just an afterthought, and the trainer's primary goal was to make a sale rather than actually help me address my dog's loose leash walking issues. The fact that she spent more time gossiping with her coworkers than observing and providing feedback on my dog's behavior was appalling. I was expecting a comprehensive and interactive seminar, but what I got was a rushed and unproductive session that left me with more questions than answers. The trainer's attempt to sell me a harness and treats was not only unprofessional but also insensitive, considering my dog was already wearing a similar harness. It seemed like she had a scripted sales pitch that she was determined to follow, regardless of my dog's actual needs. I was also put off by her pushy attempt to enroll me in her intermediate class, which I declined due to the lack of confidence I had in her training abilities. Overall, I would not recommend this training seminar or trainer to anyone, and I'm extremely disappointed in the level of service provided by Petsmart. For a company that claims to care about pets, they certainly didn't show it in this instance.

The lack of hospitality and poor service only added to our disappointing experience. It's clear that the restaurant is more focused on its trendy, organic label than actually providing a quality dining experience. The fact that the waitress didn't even attempt to make us feel welcome or apologize for the subpar food is a clear indication of the establishment's priorities. As we left, I couldn't help but feel that we had wasted our time and money on a meal that was not only unappetizing but also uncomfortable. The combination of bad food, poor acoustics, and inconsiderate patrons made for a truly awful experience. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone and will definitely not be returning. The fact that they can't even get the basics right is a shame, and the "organic" label is just a facade for their lack of culinary skill.

We had a wonderful evening, the ambiance was perfect, and the staff were attentive and knowledgeable, making our dining experience truly unforgettable and leaving us eager to return and recommend to others.

I was impressed by their wide range of sizes and styles. The owner and her granddaughter provided excellent customer service, helping me find the perfect fit. Overall, I'm glad I discovered their new location and look forward to returning for all my intimate apparel needs in a welcoming atmosphere.

As we sat down at our newly chosen table, I couldn't help but feel a sense of relief, but also a bit of frustration that we had to ask to be moved in the first place. The ambiance of the restaurant was lively and modern, with flashy decor and a bustling atmosphere, but it didn't quite make up for the subpar food and service. Our server, while attentive at times, seemed more focused on ensuring we tipped well than providing genuine hospitality. The food, as I mentioned earlier, was mediocre at best, with the Jambalaya being the highlight of our meal, but even that was nothing special. The portions were decent, but not large enough to justify the hefty prices. We left feeling somewhat disappointed and a bit ripped off, even with the Groupon deal. For a restaurant with such a flashy reputation, I expected more in terms of quality and service. Perhaps Sugar Factory is better suited for those looking for a trendy spot to take Instagram photos, rather than a genuine dining experience. Overall, I would not recommend Sugar Factory to anyone looking for a good meal at a reasonable price. There are far better options available, and I would not be returning to this establishment anytime soon. The experience was a letdown, and the strip pricing only added to our disappointment.

I was shocked and appalled by her lack of empathy and understanding. It's clear that her priority is making money, not providing quality patient care. The fact that she would try to send me to a detox center without even considering my medical history or current treatment plan is alarming. Her dismissive attitude and unwillingness to work with me to find a solution that fit my needs was the final straw. I would not recommend Dr. Basu to my worst enemy, let alone someone who is genuinely seeking medical help. If you value your health and well-being, stay far away from this doctor and find someone who actually cares.

Despite that unpleasant incident, I've returned to this frozen yogurt place and am glad to see that the staff has improved in handling such situations. The store is always clean and well-maintained, which is a big plus. The variety of flavors and toppings is still impressive, and I appreciate the unique options like Taro and Red Bean. The pay-by-the-ounce system is also convenient, allowing me to try a little of everything without breaking the bank. Overall, this remains my go-to spot for frozen yogurt, and I'm happy to see that they've addressed my previous concerns. With its wide selection and improved customer experience, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a sweet treat.

Despite the subpar service, the quality of the food and the overall atmosphere of the FB kept us from leaving completely disappointed. The warm chicken salad was cooked to perfection, with tender chicken and a delicious blend of flavors. The veggie scramble was also a hit, with a generous portion of fresh vegetables and a fluffy texture. The biscuits, as I mentioned earlier, were a unique twist on the traditional Southern biscuit, and paired well with the honey. It's worth noting that our experience with the service was not typical of our previous visits to the FB. In the past, we've had friendly and attentive waitstaff who were always happy to refill our drinks and clear our plates. Yesterday's experience was a departure from that, and we were surprised to have to ask repeatedly for basic necessities like coffee and water. Overall, while the service was a letdown, the food and atmosphere at the FB are still top-notch. With a little more attention to detail and some improved service, this place could easily earn a five-star review from us. As it stands, we'll still be back for the warm chicken salad and those delicious biscuits, but we'll be keeping an eye on the service to see if it improves. Maybe it was just an off day, but we're willing to give them another chance to show us what they're capable of.
The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot to catch up with friends or watch a game, with friendly staff and delicious pub fare that never disappoints.

The atmosphere remains lively and entertaining, making it a great spot for families and first-time visitors. Despite the touristy vibe, the area's charm and welcoming nature make it worth a visit, with its unique blend of culture and commerce on full display.

Since the review provided is already quite comprehensive and concludes with a recommendation, I will create a hypothetical continuation that assumes the reviewer has revisited Daily Dose or has more to share about their experience or observations since their initial review. Here's a possible continuation: Continuing from my last visit in 2013, I've had the pleasure of returning to Daily Dose several times, and I'm pleased to report that the quality and creativity of their menu have not only been maintained but have also evolved. One of the standout aspects of Daily Dose is its ability to innovate while keeping the classics that regulars like myself have come to love. For instance, on my last visit, I noticed they had introduced a seasonal menu that incorporated fresh, locally sourced ingredients, which added a delightful twist to some of their signature dishes. The service has also been consistently friendly and attentive, with the staff being knowledgeable about the menu and happy to offer recommendations. This personal touch, combined with the welcoming atmosphere of the restaurant, makes Daily Dose not just a great place for food but also for meeting friends or enjoying a solo meal. For those with dietary restrictions or preferences, Daily Dose has shown a commitment to inclusivity by expanding their options for gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian patrons. This consideration for a wide range of dietary needs is commendable and ensures that everyone can find something that suits their taste and requirements. Whether you're a local looking for a reliable brunch spot or a visitor seeking a memorable dining experience in the Scottsdale area, Daily Dose is a must-visit destination. Its unique blend of traditional breakfast favorites with innovative twists, combined with its excellent service and welcoming ambiance, solidifies its position as one of the top choices for breakfast and brunch in the region.

I am extremely dissatisfied with the level of service I received from this company. The lack of communication and consistency between their sales team, customer service, and technicians is appalling. It's clear that they are more focused on making a sale and locking you into a contract than actually providing a effective solution to your pest problem. The fact that I was given incorrect information about the frequency of the service and the cost is unacceptable. The technicians who came to my home seemed untrained and uneducated about the pests they were supposed to be treating. The suggestion to put Drano down my drains was not only unhelpful but also potentially harmful. The gnat trap cups that were left for me were a joke, and I was still left dealing with the same problem. The $75 cancellation fee is just the cherry on top of a terrible experience. I would not recommend this service to anyone and would advise others to beware of their deceptive practices. Save your money and look elsewhere for a reliable and effective pest control service. Overall, my experience with this company was a complete waste of time and money.

and the naan bread is freshly made in a tandoor oven. The service is also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who are happy to make recommendations. The portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable. We tried a variety of dishes, including the palak paneer and the chicken tikka masala, and everything was delicious. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a great spot for a night out with family or friends. Overall, we highly recommend this restaurant for its unique decor, tasty food, and excellent service. It's a hidden gem worth discovering.

As I sat in the waiting area before my treatment, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment. The decor, although modern and sleek, lacked a personal touch and felt more like a hotel lobby than a relaxing spa. The calming music and gentle water features that are typically found in spas were noticeably absent, making it difficult for me to unwind. When I was called in for my massage, I was greeted by Bryan, my therapist, who was friendly and professional. He did a good job of working out the kinks in my muscles, and the foot scrub was a nice addition to the treatment. However, the experience was somewhat marred by the fact that the massage room was not as peaceful as I had hoped. I could hear muffled conversations and the sound of footsteps outside, which made it difficult for me to fully relax. Despite the disappointing atmosphere, I did appreciate the amenities that the spa had to offer. The locker room was clean and well-stocked, and the showers were spacious and comfortable. However, the overall experience was not enough to make me want to return. As I left the spa, I couldn't help but compare it to other spas I've visited in the area, such as the Montelucia, which offers a much more luxurious and relaxing experience. Perhaps with a few tweaks to the decor and a greater emphasis on creating a peaceful atmosphere, the Revive Spa could live up to its name and provide a truly rejuvenating experience for its clients. Until then, I'll be taking my business (and my voucher dollars) elsewhere.

I was thoroughly disappointed and frustrated with my experience at Mac's, and I would not recommend their take-out service to anyone. The combination of rude customer service and subpar food is a recipe for disaster. As someone who was looking forward to enjoying a delicious plate of BBQ, I was shocked and appalled by the lack of quality and care that went into preparing my order. The fact that the food was room temperature and lacked any semblance of flavor or texture was a major red flag. The soggy Texas toast, dried-out mac n cheese, and vinegar-based coleslaw were all inedible. But the biggest disappointment was the BBQ itself, which was fatty, chopped, and completely devoid of sauce. For a place that claims to specialize in BBQ, it's unacceptable to serve such a low-quality product. What's even more egregious is the price point. $14.00 for a single plate of food is already steep, but when you consider the small portion size and poor quality of the food, it's downright outrageous. I feel ripped off and taken advantage of, and I would advise others to steer clear of Mac's take-out service. Overall, my experience at Mac's was a disaster from start to finish. From the rude customer service to the subpar food, it's clear that this establishment is not interested in providing a quality experience for its customers. Unless they seriously revamp their take-out service and focus on providing fresh, flavorful food, I would not recommend wasting your time or money at Mac's. There are far better options available, and I will be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

I've also had the pleasure of trying their other menu items, such as the pulled pork and chicken, but like I mentioned earlier, the brisket remains my top choice. The portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the food. The service is always friendly and efficient, whether we're dining in or taking out. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it a great spot for families or a quick dinner with friends. One thing I appreciate about this place is the consistency of their food. Every time we visit, the brisket is tender and flavorful, and the sauce is always rich and tangy. They also offer a variety of sides, including coleslaw, baked beans, and potato salad, which are all tasty and complement the meats well. While I still haven't found a BBQ joint that exactly replicates the homemade BBQ sauce from my Oklahoma days, this place comes close, and I'm grateful to have found it here in Vegas. Overall, I highly recommend this BBQ joint to anyone looking for delicious, authentic BBQ at a fair price. Whether you're a local or just visiting, it's definitely worth a try.

The food quality was subpar and the atmosphere was uncomfortable. To top it off, the bill was incorrect, adding to our frustration. We left feeling disrespected and unhappy, vowing never to return. The lack of customer service and attention to detail was appalling. Needless to say, I would not recommend this establishment to anyone, and I hope others can avoid the disappointment we endured.

As a paying customer, I expect to be treated with respect and not coerced into leaving a tip that I don't feel is deserved. The fact that they had the audacity to tell me what I should tip is appalling and speaks to a larger issue with their business model. It's clear that they are more concerned with lining their own pockets than providing a quality service to their customers. The massage itself was average, but the lack of privacy and proper equipment was a major drawback. Despite this, I continued to visit the business, hoping that they would improve or that I would eventually receive a better experience. However, the treatment I received as a repeat customer was disappointing, to say the least. The fact that they would question my tip and imply that I was being cheap is not only rude but also ungrateful. I believe that customers should be able to tip based on the quality of service they receive, without feeling pressured or guilt-tripped into leaving more. The fact that this business feels entitled to a certain amount of money from their customers is a major turn-off and has ensured that I will never return. I would advise others to think twice before supporting a business that prioritizes profits over customer satisfaction and respect.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it a nice spot to relax and unwind. Although the prices may be steep for some, the quality of the food and exceptional service make it a worthwhile experience. If you're looking to treat yourself or try something new, this pizzeria might be the place to go, just be prepared for the higher cost. With a little more competitive pricing, this place could easily become a favorite among locals and visitors alike.

Our server seemed overwhelmed, but the staff's friendly nature made up for it. Overall, Brat Haus is a great spot for a relaxed meal with delicious German-inspired food and a wide selection of beers, making it a definite recommendation for a fun night out with friends.

Overall, my experience at this store was disappointing, to say the least. The excellent location and wide selection of products were completely overshadowed by the subpar service. As a customer, I expect to be acknowledged and assisted in a timely manner, especially when I'm looking for something specific. The fact that the clerk ignored me and prioritized his conversation with another customer was unprofessional and inconsiderate. The lack of effort to help me find an alternative or offer to check stock at other stores was the final nail in the coffin. For a store with such a great location and selection, it's surprising that they wouldn't prioritize customer service. Unless they revamp their approach to customer interaction, I would not recommend this store to others. With so many other options available, it's easy to take your business elsewhere and receive the service you deserve.
to go back and try their other options, the flavors and portions are well worth the price and the staff's friendly attitude makes it a great dining experience.

The staff is generally friendly and helpful, although sometimes a bit slow. Overall, it's a convenient location with standard CVS prices and services. The text notifications are a nice touch, making it easy to plan pickups. Nothing exceptional, but it reliably meets my pharmacy needs, and Sampson's namesake always brings a smile to my face.

The donuts are amazing and super-fattening of course, but then I guess you shouldn't be eating donuts if you are concerned with your weight. I've tried several types, including the classic glazed and the creative maple bacon, and each one has been a delight. The owners' attention to detail and commitment to using high-quality ingredients are evident in every bite. Whether you're a donut aficionado or just looking to satisfy your sweet tooth, People's Bakery is a must-visit destination. In addition to the donuts, I've also had the opportunity to try some of the bakery's savory offerings, and I must say that they are equally impressive. The gyros, as I mentioned earlier, are authentic and delicious, with a perfect balance of flavors and textures. The falafel is crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, with a unique blend of spices that sets it apart from other versions I've tried. And the Tan Tan Chicken is a real showstopper, with its rich, aromatic flavors and generous portion size. One of the things that really sets People's Bakery apart from other eateries in Madison is the warmth and hospitality of the owners. They are truly passionate about their craft, and it shows in every aspect of the bakery, from the carefully prepared dishes to the cozy and inviting atmosphere. Whether you're a longtime resident of Madison or just visiting, People's Bakery is a gem that is sure to delight and leave you feeling like you've discovered a hidden treasure. I've been to my fair share of bakeries and restaurants in Madison, but People's Bakery is hands-down my favorite. The combination of delicious food, warm atmosphere, and exceptional service makes it a standout in a city that can sometimes feel overrun with mediocre eateries. So if you're looking for a truly exceptional dining experience, look no further than People's Bakery. With its mouth-watering donuts, authentic gyros, and creative savory dishes, it's a destination that is sure to satisfy even the most discerning palate.

The service wasn't much better, our server seemed overwhelmed and it took a while to get our orders taken. The atmosphere, although nicely decorated, felt somewhat empty and lacking in energy. For the prices they're charging, I expected a lot more in terms of quality and flavor. It's clear that the kitchen is struggling to deliver on their menu promises. The fact that the chicken wings were the only redeeming dish is not enough to save the overall experience. With so many other great dining options available, it's hard to see why anyone would choose to eat here. Unfortunately, our first and only visit was a major letdown, and we won't be recommending this place to anyone. Unless they seriously revamp their menu and cooking techniques, it's unlikely we'll ever give them another chance. Overall, a disappointing experience that failed to meet our expectations.

Overall, our experience was pleasant, but not exceptional. The rooftop seating offered stunning views of the surrounding area, which was definitely a highlight. However, the service, although decent, lacked a personal touch, which made it feel somewhat impersonal. The food, while tasty, didn't particularly stand out, except for the crab cakes in my Eggs Oscar dish. The corn chowder was creamy and flavorful, but the Bloody Mary, made with a mix, was a letdown. The mimosas, on the other hand, were refreshing and well-made. Despite the beautiful setting and good food, the subpar service and unremarkable drinks left us feeling indifferent about returning. Perhaps with a more engaging server and a few tweaks to their cocktail menu, this place could reach its full potential and become a must-visit destination. Until then, it's just an average brunch spot with a great view.

The lack of attention to detail and inability to get a simple order right is unacceptable. As someone who works in the food industry, I understand that mistakes can happen, but three times is just ridiculous. The fact that it took over 30 minutes to receive my initial order and an additional 20 minutes to try and correct the mistakes is also inexcusable. The staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized, which is not an excuse for the poor service I received. Overall, my experience at this Johnny Rockets was extremely disappointing and I would not recommend it to anyone. The manager's response to my complaints was also unimpressive, failing to offer a sincere apology or a suitable solution.

The variety of tacos was impressive, with everything from traditional carne asada to more unique options like Korean BBQ and vegan choices. The lines for each vendor were manageable, and the staff were friendly and efficient. The extra tickets we received were a bonus, allowing us to try even more tacos and drinks. The atmosphere was lively and festive, with great music and plenty of seating areas to relax and enjoy our food. Overall, I would definitely attend this event again and recommend it to fellow taco lovers. The combination of delicious food, good vibes, and great value made for an unforgettable experience.

As I walked out of the store, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and frustrated with the experience. I had been a loyal Sprint customer for years, and it was disheartening to see such a lack of attention and care from the staff. The fact that the associate had yelled at me initially and then proceeded to ignore me while chatting with another customer was unprofessional and inconsiderate. I decided to drive to the other Sprint store I had in mind, which was about 20 minutes further away. As I arrived, I was greeted with a warm smile and a friendly hello. The staff was attentive and helpful, answering all my questions and addressing my concerns about upgrading my plan. The contrast between the two stores was staggering, and I was relieved to have found a location that actually cared about its customers. My experience at the first store was a stark reminder that customer service is still a crucial aspect of any business. As a customer, I expect to be treated with respect and attention, especially when I'm considering making a significant purchase or commitment. Unfortunately, the first store failed to meet these basic expectations, and I would not recommend it to anyone. On the other hand, the second store redeemed Sprint's reputation in my eyes, and I would happily return there for any future needs.
Always a great experience with a fun atmosphere and reasonable prices every time we visit this wonderful local restaurant establishment.

I've been to this Gap store a handful of times, and while it's not my go-to destination, it's a reliable spot to pick up some quality basics. The store's layout, although a bit cramped, is still easy to navigate, and I appreciate how they've made the most of the available space. The clothes themselves are, as I mentioned, classic Gap fare - simple, well-made, and versatile. I've had good luck with their sales, too, and have managed to snag some great deals on items like jeans and sweaters. One thing that does bother me is the inconsistency of the staff. As I mentioned earlier, some of them are really friendly and helpful, while others seem completely disinterested. I've had experiences where I've asked for help finding a specific item, only to be met with a shrug or a vague gesture towards the general area of the store. It's not a huge deal, but it can be a bit frustrating when you're trying to find something specific. Despite these minor quibbles, I'd still recommend this Gap store to anyone looking for some reliable, affordable basics. It may not be the most exciting shopping experience, but it gets the job done, and the quality of the clothes is generally high. Plus, it's convenient to have a Gap location right in the heart of Edinburgh, especially when you're in a pinch and need something quickly. All in all, I'm happy to give this store a solid 4 out of 5 stars - it may not be perfect, but it's a solid choice for anyone looking for some classic, dependable clothing.

to visit this establishment. Despite the lengthy wait, our server's friendly demeanor and the kitchen's generosity in not charging us for the forgotten soup went a long way in making up for the delay. It's clear that the staff is dedicated to providing a positive experience, even when things don't go exactly as planned. The food, once it arrived, was certainly worth the wait. The pea soup, as I mentioned earlier, was a highlight, and the pasties were creative and expertly filled. I appreciated the variety of options on the menu, from classic combinations like the Rosemary Steak Pasty to more adventurous choices like the Lamb Vindaloo. While the heat level of the vindaloo was more than I could handle, the flavors were complex and well-balanced, and I appreciated the generous portion of lamb and potatoes. My boyfriend's Rosemary Steak Pasty was a standout, with the tender steak and roasted red peppers pairing beautifully with the rich brie cheese. The mustard cream sauce, while not to my taste, added a tangy and creamy element to the dish. It's clear that the kitchen is committed to using high-quality ingredients and taking the time to prepare each dish with care. The desserts, too, were a highlight of the meal. My peanut butter and jelly pasty was a masterclass in sweet and savory flavors, with the banana and raspberry jelly adding natural sweetness and the peanut butter providing a rich and creamy element. The whipped cream on top was the perfect finishing touch. My boyfriend's sticky toffee pudding, while not to my taste, was clearly a hit with him, and I appreciated the creative touch of naming it after Shirley Temple. In retrospect, I think our experience would have been greatly improved by visiting on a less busy night. The staff seemed overwhelmed at times, and the wait between courses was longer than ideal. However, the quality of the food and the friendly service made up for these issues, and I'm eager to return and try more of the menu. With a little more planning and a less crowded evening, I have no doubt that this restaurant could easily earn a full five stars. As it stands, I'm happy to give it three and a half, with the caveat that visitors should be prepared for a potentially lengthy wait on busy nights.

Despite the uneven distribution of ingredients, the flavors were still incredible, and you could tell that the owners were committed to using high-quality ingredients. The atmosphere was also cozy and inviting, with a modern decor that still managed to feel warm and welcoming. Our server was knowledgeable and friendly, happy to answer questions about the menu and make recommendations. The prices were also very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the ingredients and the care that clearly went into making each pizza. If they can work on getting the ingredient distribution down, this place could easily become our go-to spot for pizza. As it stands, it's still a great option, and I'm excited to come back and try some of their other menu items. The fact that they're using authentic Neapolitan techniques and ingredients is a major plus, and I appreciate the attention to detail that they're bringing to the table. Overall, a great experience, and I'm looking forward to seeing how they continue to evolve and improve.

which might make it more appealing to try again. The food quality is indeed good, and the Sunday special menu could be a more budget-friendly option. However, for the regular prices, I expect a more upscale atmosphere and exceptional service, which this restaurant lacks. Perhaps with some renovations and attention to detail, it could justify the high prices. Until then, I would recommend exploring other options in the area that offer better value for the money. The Sunday special might be worth trying, but overall, it's an average dining experience at a premium price.

The combination of flavors and textures was impressive, and the portion sizes were generous. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable, happy to answer questions about the menu. The outdoor seating area was lively, yet we were able to carry on a conversation easily. Overall, I'm so glad I gave this place a second chance, as it has now become a favorite spot to dine on State Street. Highly recommend for a casual, delicious meal.

Overall, our experience was exceptional, and we left feeling satisfied. The combination of excellent food, drinks, and service made for a wonderful evening out. Sean's attentive and informative approach added to the ambiance, making us feel valued as customers. We would definitely recommend this establishment to others and look forward to returning soon to try more of their offerings.

Unfortunately, this location fell short of expectations. The unpleasant experience was a turn-off, making me hesitant to return. However, I hope they'll improve their food handling and presentation to match the high standards of other Jersey Mike's locations I've visited, which were truly exceptional and left a lasting impression on me.

Despite the drawbacks, the hotel's luxurious ambiance and spacious rooms made our stay enjoyable. The kitchen area was a nice touch, and the view of Treasure Island was a lovely bonus. However, the lack of self-parking and unreliable hot water were notable inconveniences. The location, although convenient for shopping, was not ideal for exploring the strip, especially in high heels. To avoid the valet wait, we opted to park at the mall across the street on occasion. Overall, I would recommend this hotel for those seeking a classy, casino-free experience, but be prepared for the valet fees and potential hot water issues. With some minor adjustments, this hotel could truly shine.

I was really looking forward to making a purchase at Fashion by Robert Black, but the whole experience ended up being a huge disappointment. The lack of communication and follow-through from the staff was unprofessional and frustrating. I understand that mistakes can happen, but it's how they're handled that matters. In this case, it seemed like no one took ownership of the issue or made an effort to resolve it. I ended up leaving empty-handed and feeling like my business wasn't valued. The store's unique selection of vintage clothing is definitely a draw, but poor customer service can quickly outweigh any advantages. Unfortunately, my experience has left a sour taste, and I won't be recommending Fashion by Robert Black to friends or family. There are plenty of other vintage shops out there that prioritize customer satisfaction, and I'll be taking my business elsewhere.

I must say, I was surprised to receive a call from the owner, apologizing for the inconvenience and offering to make my pizza. It was a nice gesture, but it was too little, too late. The fact that I had already had to go through the trouble of contacting my bank to reverse the transaction and was left with a bad taste in my mouth made it difficult for me to accept their apology at face value. I appreciate the owner's effort to make things right, but it's clear that there are some serious issues with their online ordering system and communication with customers. As I mentioned earlier, I've had problems with online ordering from Mama Mia Pizza before, and it seems like they haven't made any effort to address these issues. It's disappointing, because I do think they have good pizza. I've enjoyed their food in the past, but the hassle and frustration of trying to order online has outweighed any positive experiences I've had with their food. I would advise others to avoid ordering online from Mama Mia Pizza and instead opt for in-person or phone orders. It's a shame, because online ordering is a convenient option that many people rely on, but until they get their system sorted out, it's just not worth the risk. Overall, my experience with Mama Mia Pizza has left a sour taste in my mouth. While I appreciate the owner's apology and offer to make things right, it's too late to redeem my lost faith in their business. I won't be going back, and I would caution others to be wary of their online ordering system. With a little more attention to customer service and a functional online ordering system, Mama Mia Pizza could be a great option for pizza lovers. But until then, I'll be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

The service, despite the wait, was friendly and attentive. The staff were apologetic about the delay and made sure we had everything we needed. The atmosphere, although small, was cozy and inviting, making us feel like we were part of the family. We appreciated the authentic Indian cuisine and the fact that they didn't hold back on the spice level. Overall, it was a great experience and we're looking forward to our next visit, hoping that the wait time will be shorter and earning them that fifth star. Definitely recommended for spice lovers like ourselves.

Overall, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of food and service at this sports bar. The atmosphere was lively and energetic, with plenty of screens to catch your favorite game. The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. I appreciated the creative twists on classic pub fare, such as the Brie and green apple topping on the turkey burger. While not every dish was a home run, the prime rib special was a great value and the clam chowder was a standout. The beer selection was also impressive, with a variety of local and regional brews on tap. I would definitely recommend this spot to friends and family looking for a fun, casual dining experience with a sports-themed twist. With its modern decor, attentive service, and tasty food, this sports bar is a great addition to the local dining scene.

Our server was attentive and friendly, refilling drinks promptly. Overall, while the food was just average, the excellent service made up for it. We might return to try other menu items, hoping to find something with more flavor. For now, it's an okay spot for Mexican food, but not our top choice. Perhaps with some tweaks to their recipes, they could elevate their dishes and become a go-to destination.

The overall experience was a disaster, and I left feeling frustrated and ripped off. The prices were exorbitant, especially considering the subpar quality of the food. The lack of seasoning and care in preparation was evident in every dish. The atmosphere, while initially intriguing for my kids, quickly became kitschy and annoying. The animatronic jungle animals, which I assume were meant to be a unique feature, came across as cheap and tacky. With so many other dining options available, I would strongly advise against wasting your time and money at this overhyped and overpriced establishment. Needless to say, my family and I will not be returning.

The atmosphere is always lively, and their themed nights are a blast. Friendly staff and a wide selection of drinks make it a great spot to meet new people and have a fantastic time, making the drive from Kankakee completely worthwhile every time.

Overall, I can see why this place is so highly rated among coffee connoisseurs, but as a casual coffee drinker with a family, I didn't quite feel welcome. The vanilla latte I ordered was expertly crafted, and the flavors were rich and well-balanced. The coffee cake was also a highlight, moist and flavorful with a perfect crumb. However, the negative experiences I had with the barista and the unwelcoming atmosphere towards my young son really brought down my overall rating. I understand that this place is likely catering to a specific crowd, but as a business, I believe it's essential to be inclusive and respectful to all customers, regardless of their coffee knowledge or family status. Perhaps with some adjustments to their customer service and pricing transparency, I would consider revisiting and revising my rating. Until then, I'll stick with my 3-star review.

Great Food with Spanish Flair I originally came here to see a band performing outside. It is a very interesting venue for music, since it is outdoors, with busy Chuck Blvd. on the south side of the property. While the band was performing, there was a semi-nude model and artists/other people painting her (or, rather, their vision of her). Lots of metal and rivets in styling which I like. More industrial than steampunk. I had the Garlic Pollo & House Fries (tapas menu items) and a Stella. The chicken was cooked perfectly, tender with good garlic flavor without being overpowering. The fries were also very solid, rustic planks with a bit of skin on on the tips (wink, wink, nudge, nudge). Loved the Mojo mayo & spicy ketchup that were served with the fries. The service was great and I talked to a manager and (I think) one of the owners. They seem to be fun people with an eye towards full entertainment, not just food & drink. I really want to come here for brunch, just gotta wait for my lady to be with. Short review, but I want to add to this after brunch. Overall, my experience at this venue was fantastic, with the unique blend of food, art, and music creating a lively atmosphere that sets it apart from other restaurants. The fact that they have outdoor events and activities adds to the excitement, making it a great spot to hang out and enjoy some delicious Spanish-inspired cuisine. I'm looking forward to trying their brunch menu and seeing what other events they have in store. With its eclectic vibe and commitment to entertainment, this place is definitely a hidden gem worth exploring. I'll be sure to update this review after my next visit, but for now, I highly recommend giving it a try.

Overall, my experience was disappointing due to poor service and unpleasant atmosphere, ensuring I won't return to this establishment in the future, seeking better quality and cleanliness elsewhere for my dining needs.

I was thoroughly impressed with the attention to detail and the extra effort the staff put in to ensure my car was cleaned to perfection. The facility is well-maintained and clean, making it a comfortable place to wait while your car is being detailed. The prices are very competitive, and the quality of work is exceptional. I've already recommended this place to friends and family, and I'll definitely be back for future detailing needs. The staff's kindness and willingness to go above and beyond has earned my loyalty, and I'm excited to see the consistent quality of service they provide.

Overall, the experience fell short of expectations. The ambiance was nice, but the pushy service and mediocre food, including the overhyped molten cake, left a negative impression. For the price, I expected a more exceptional dining experience, especially from a reputable steakhouse. Sadly, Houston's remains my top choice for a superior steakhouse experience.

Despite some reservations about the quality, I've been pleased with my purchase so far. The cami has been a great addition to my summer wardrobe and the colour is really vibrant. I've worn it a few times and received plenty of compliments. The staff in this branch are always helpful and friendly, which makes a big difference to the overall shopping experience. They're happy to offer advice and help with sizing, which can be useful as Jane Norman's sizes can be a bit inconsistent. Overall, while Jane Norman may not be my go-to destination for high-quality clothing, this branch is definitely worth a visit for a affordable and trendy pieces. With student discount available, it's a great place to pick up a bargain.

Very disappointing experience overall, with multiple mistakes and a lengthy wait for corrections. The lack of attention to detail and slow service made for a frustrating meal, leaving a bad taste and a strong desire to warn others to avoid this establishment altogether.

The sizzling sounds and aromas of the grill only add to the excitement, making our mouths water in anticipation. As we devour each bite, the flavors explode, and the tenderness of the meats is impressive. The service is also top-notch, with friendly staff constantly refilling our drinks and clearing our plates. Overall, Sura is the perfect spot for a late-night, meat-filled indulgence, and we can't wait to come back and do it all again. Just remember to dress accordingly and plan for a meat-scented exit.

The lack of attention to detail and careless mistakes have become a norm here. Simple orders are consistently botched, and the wait times are unacceptable. It's disappointing to see a brand like McDonald's, known for its efficiency and convenience, fail so miserably. I've tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, but it's clear that there's a deeper issue with management or training. Until they address these problems, I'll be taking my business (and my sanity) elsewhere. Hopefully, someone from corporate will take notice and make some much-needed changes to turn this location around.

Overall, my experience at this buffet was a letdown, especially given the hefty price tag. While I appreciate the effort to offer a diverse range of options, the execution fell short in many areas. The lackluster quality of the food, particularly the seafood and desserts, was a major disappointment. For a city like Las Vegas, where culinary excellence is abundant, this buffet simply doesn't measure up. Unless they revamp their menu and improve the quality of their dishes, I would not recommend wasting your time or money here. There are far better options available, even for those looking to splurge. In fact, I would suggest exploring other buffets or restaurants in the area that offer better value for the price. With so many exceptional dining experiences to be had in Las Vegas, it's hard to justify settling for mediocrity, especially when it comes with a premium price tag. Ultimately, I would advise others to keep looking and explore the numerous other culinary options that Las Vegas has to offer.

I was impressed by her attention to detail and willingness to help. Her kindness and expertise made a positive impact on my experience. The extra effort she put in ensured my package was properly secured for shipping. I'll definitely be returning to this location for any future shipping needs, grateful for the excellent customer service and helpful advice provided.

As I reflected on our experience, I couldn't help but think that LAX has the potential to be a great spot, but it seems like they're struggling to strike the right balance. The crowd was overwhelming, and the atmosphere felt more like a frat house than a nightclub. I've been to plenty of other clubs in the area that have managed to create a more enjoyable and safe environment for their patrons. The music, although not my personal favorite, was at least loud and energetic, but the transitions between songs were awkward and took away from the overall vibe. Despite the friendly door staff and decent venue size, I just couldn't shake off the feeling of discomfort and unease. Maybe it was the late hour, or maybe it was the fact that the girls had already called it a night, but whatever the reason, it just didn't feel right. I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, considering the factors that might have contributed to the chaos, but at the end of the day, my experience was still subpar. Unless they make some significant changes to address the issues with crowd control and atmosphere, I'll be taking my business (and my hubby) elsewhere. For now, I'd say LAX is a hard pass from me.

Overall, our dining experience was extremely disappointing and left a bad taste in our mouths. The lack of attention to detail and quality control in the kitchen was alarming. As frequent diners, we understand that mistakes can happen, but the sheer number of errors we encountered was unacceptable. The fact that we were essentially used as test subjects for the new employee's training was unprofessional and inconsiderate. Despite the server's kindness, it was not enough to redeem the poor food and service. We will not be returning to this restaurant and would advise others to think twice before dining here.

As I navigated the worn stairs and dusty aisles, I couldn't help but feel a sense of nostalgia for the old theatres of yesteryear. Despite the physical shortcomings of the venue, the MainLine has a certain je ne sais quoi that is hard to find in more modern, sterile spaces. The intimate setting and close proximity to the performers creates an electric atmosphere that draws the audience in and refuses to let go. I've witnessed tears, laughter, and even the occasional standing ovation, all of which are a testament to the talent and dedication of the actors and production teams that bring these shows to life. While the MainLine may not be the most comfortable or glamorous venue, it is undoubtedly a hub for creative expression and a showcase for emerging talent. So, if you're looking for a unique and unforgettable theatrical experience, the MainLine is definitely worth a visit – just be sure to dress lightly and wear comfortable shoes.

We will definitely be back for more, the prices were reasonable and the overall experience was excellent, making it a great spot to relax and unwind with friends, highly recommended for seafood lovers and those who appreciate a lively atmosphere.

The staff is friendly and helpful, always willing to lend a hand. I also appreciate the cleanliness of the facility, it's well-maintained and comfortable. Overall, I'm happy with my experience at this LVAC gym and would definitely recommend it to others. The combination of great classes, variety of equipment, and supportive atmosphere makes it an ideal spot to reach my fitness goals. With convenient hours and a great location, it's perfect for fitting in a workout around my busy schedule.

As I reflect on my disastrous experience at Pick Up Stix, I am still trying to process the multitude of mishaps that occurred during my visit. From the initial struggle with the door to the baffling conversation with the lady about the house special, it was clear that this establishment was not operating at its best. The lengthy wait for our food was only the beginning, as the dishes that finally arrived were a far cry from what I would consider acceptable Chinese cuisine. The egg roll, in particular, was a travesty. Not only did it lack the characteristic flavors and textures that I have come to expect from this staple dish, but it was also served with a sweet and sour sauce that was an affront to the very concept of the condiment. The yellow color was jarring, and the taste was cloying and overly sweet. It was a bold move to deviate from the traditional red sauce, but it was a move that ultimately fell flat. But the problems with our meal didn't stop there. The rest of the food was swathed in a gloopy, overpowering sauce that dominated every bite. It was as if the kitchen had taken a look at the dishes and thought, "You know what would really make this pop? A big ol' ladle of goo!" The result was a meal that was both unappetizing and unsatisfying. In the end, my experience at Pick Up Stix was a resounding disappointment. The service was lackluster, the food was subpar, and the overall atmosphere was one of confusion and frustration. And, as the update to my review attests, the aftermath of the meal was just as unpleasant as the meal itself. If you value your taste buds and your personal relationships, stay far, far away from Pick Up Stix. Trust me, you won't be missing out on anything.

The limited seating area is usually occupied by those waiting for a friend or taking a brief break, and the atmosphere can feel a bit rushed. Despite this, the staff remains friendly and attentive, efficiently managing the constant flow of customers. The drink quality is consistent with other Starbucks locations, and the pastries are always fresh. Overall, this branch excels at providing a quick and convenient coffee fix for busy commuters, but it may not be the best choice for those seeking a relaxing coffee shop experience. It serves its purpose well in this bustling area.

I was shocked by the lack of professionalism displayed by Jennifer. Her attitude and behavior made me feel unwelcome and unvalued as a customer. The fact that she prioritized sweeping and socializing over attending to me was appalling. Max's kindness was overshadowed by Jennifer's rudeness, making my overall experience at Subway extremely disappointing. I hope the management takes necessary actions to improve their customer service, as this encounter has left a bad taste in my mouth, making me hesitant to return.

Needless to say, I was extremely disappointed. Simple mistakes like these can make or break a meal, and unfortunately, this location fell short of my expectations, making me question the quality control and attention to detail of the staff at this particular Del Taco location.

The old fridge documentary was a great find, and I'm glad it led me to this hidden gem. With its unique charm and extensive drink selection, I can see myself becoming a regular here. The bartender's knowledge of fine spirits is impressive, and their recommendations are spot on. Whether you're a connoisseur or just looking for a new spot to unwind, this place has something for everyone. I'm excited to try their food menu on my next visit and experience more of what they have to offer, but for now, the drinks have won me over.

It's disheartening to see a once beloved establishment fall so far from its former glory. The lack of attention to detail and care in preparing orders is alarming. I've tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, thinking maybe it was just an off day, but the consistent decline in quality and service has made it clear that something is amiss. The fact that they can't even be bothered to include the extra toppings I've paid for is not only frustrating but also feels like a blatant disregard for customer satisfaction. The meatball incident on the white pizza was the final straw, leaving me feeling ripped off and disappointed. As someone who has been a loyal customer for years, it's sad to see Sardellas prioritizing profits over people. Unless they make some serious changes, I'll be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere. Sardellas, you've lost a loyal customer, and I hope you take this as a wake-up call to revamp your operations and regain the trust of your patrons.

Overall, our experience was enjoyable, thanks to the friendly staff and cozy ambiance. The multi-tier chocolate cake was a highlight, rich and decadent. Although the beer prices were reasonable, the steam pot's lackluster presentation and dry mussels left a disappointing impression. Given the price point, I expected a more satisfying meal. Despite this, our group had a great time, and I would consider returning to try other menu items, hoping for a more impressive culinary experience.

The lack of attention from our server was not only frustrating but also surprising, given the number of staff members we saw milling about. It seemed like they were more interested in chatting with each other than attending to their tables. When we finally did get our food, it was just okay - not bad, but not particularly impressive either. The portions were small, and the prices were steep, which made the overall experience feel even more disappointing. As we waited for our check, we couldn't help but notice the other patrons struggling with the same issues we had. Tables around us were signaling for their servers, and the line for the unisex restroom was growing longer by the minute. It was clear that this restaurant was not equipped to handle a large crowd, and it showed in every aspect of our visit. Overall, our girls' night out was a letdown, and I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone. With so many other great options available, it's just not worth the hassle and frustration. Unless they seriously overhaul their service and amenities, I think it's best to steer clear of this place.

The Vig Rig is a fantastic service that allows you to enjoy your favorite drinks without worrying about transportation. The staff is always friendly and attentive, making sure you have a great experience. Whether you're meeting friends for brunch or just grabbing a drink after work, The Vig is a great choice. The outdoor seating area is also a plus, providing a comfortable spot to relax and enjoy the Arizona weather. Overall, The Vig is a must-visit spot in Central Phoenix, offering a unique and enjoyable experience that will keep you coming back for more. With its fun atmosphere and great amenities, it's the perfect place to unwind and have a good time.

Overall, it was an average dining experience. The prices were reasonable, and the atmosphere was quiet and clean. While nothing stood out, nothing was terribly disappointing either. I might give it another try to see if their other dishes impress, but for now, it's just an okay option in my book.

I find it extremely frustrating and inconvenient to deal with this credit card company. The lack of transparency and outdated payment methods are unacceptable. It's astonishing that in today's digital age, they still don't accept debit cards or online payments with credit/debit cards. The fact that I incurred a $30 fee due to their website issue is appalling. The hassle and wasted time I've experienced trying to pay my bill have been a nightmare. I've had to take time off work to visit the mall just to make a payment, which is not only inconvenient but also a waste of my time and resources. I would not recommend this credit card to anyone, and I'm counting down the days until I can pay off my balance and close my account for good. The company needs to seriously revamp its payment system and customer service to make it more user-friendly and efficient.
Staff is friendly, attentive, and courteous, making the experience slightly more enjoyable despite the average quality of the food offerings available.

Overall, our dining experience was exceptional, and we would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a delicious meal before a show. The chefs' table seating added a unique touch, allowing us to witness the culinary magic firsthand. The service was top-notch, with our server being attentive and efficient. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the food and the convenient location. We left feeling satisfied and impressed, with just enough time to grab our seats at the Blumenthal before the show started. The combination of great food, excellent service, and perfect timing made for a wonderful evening out, and we can't wait to come back and try more of their dishes.

The Coconut cake was moist, BAT crepe deliciously rich, but Millefeuille stole the show with its perfect pastry layers and creamy filling, making the trip somewhat worthwhile despite the Mille cake disappointment, leaving me eager to reserve and try it another time.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but notice the eerie silence that filled the restaurant. The lack of ambiance and background noise made the experience feel somewhat awkward, and I found myself wondering if the counter service model was to blame. The food, while delicious, wasn't enough to distract from the overall lack of energy in the space. I think the owner has a great concept, but the execution is falling short. The menu is interesting and diverse, and the quality of the ingredients is evident in the dishes. However, the casual, counter-service approach may not be the best fit for a restaurant located in a more upscale area like Arrowhead. The full bar, which seemed almost like an afterthought, has the potential to be a major draw, but it's not being utilized to its full potential. To turn things around, I would suggest that the owner consider making some significant changes. Switching to table service would not only provide a more traditional dining experience but also allow the staff to engage with customers and create a more welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, revamping the signage and marketing materials to better reflect the type of cuisine and experience offered would likely help attract more customers. With a few tweaks, this restaurant could potentially thrive, but as it stands, I fear that it may struggle to stay afloat.

The atmosphere is lively and inviting, with friendly staff and a great selection of music. Whether it's a quick bite or a night out, this place never disappoints. We always leave feeling satisfied and already planning our next visit, it's definitely our go-to spot for any occasion.

I've tried to give Cracked the benefit of the doubt, thinking that maybe it was just a one-time mistake, but unfortunately, it's been a consistent issue every time I've visited. The quality of their ingredients and cooking is undeniable, but it's a shame that it's being let down by the subpar bread. I've had their burgers, sandwiches, and even breakfast items, and the bread has been a disappointment every time. It's not just about personal preference; a good bun can make or break a sandwich. I've seen other restaurants in the area, like Black Dog, get it right with their soft and squishy buns. I'm begging Cracked to take a page out of their book and revamp their bread game. It's time to ditch the hockey-puck-like buns and opt for something that will complement their delicious fillings. Until then, I'll be eating the filling and leaving the bun behind, which is a shame because I really want to love this place. Come on, Cracked, listen to your customers and give us the soft, squishy buns we deserve!
Unfortunately, the unpleasant surprise overshadowed the great taste, making my overall experience extremely disappointing and unappetizing.
Overall, our experience was average, and the high prices didn't match the quality or speed of service, making it unlikely for us to return to this establishment anytime soon for breakfast.

The contrast between the two stores was staggering. At AZ Art Supply, the staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to assist. They helped me find everything on my list and even made some great recommendations. The store was well-organized and easy to navigate. I was impressed by the wide selection of art supplies and the competitive prices. Overall, I highly recommend AZ Art Supply over the other store, and I will definitely be returning to AZ Art Supply for all my art needs.

The staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized, leading to further frustration. Poor communication and long wait times made the experience even more unpleasant, solidifying my decision to choose a different rental agency in the future.

Needless to say, I was extremely disappointed. The entire experience was a letdown, and the prices didn't match the poor quality. For $75, I expected much better. Unfortunately, this place failed to deliver on every dish, leaving a bad taste in my mouth, literally and figuratively, a huge waste of money.

Overall, my experience at Firesky Resort & Spa was nothing short of exceptional. The attention to detail and commitment to excellence were evident in every aspect of my stay. From the moment I arrived, I felt pampered and relaxed, and the staff's warm hospitality only added to the ambiance. The resort's amenities, such as the pool area and spa services, were top-notch and perfectly designed to help guests unwind and rejuvenate.
