While the presence of video poker machines is still a drawback, Crown & Anchor does its best to minimize their impact on the overall ambiance. Overall, if you're looking for a classic pub experience in Vegas, Crown & Anchor is a solid choice. Just be prepared for a few distractions from the video poker machines, and you'll be all set for a fun and memorable night out. With its winning combination of good drinks, tasty food, and lively atmosphere, Crown & Anchor is a must-visit destination for anyone seeking a authentic pub experience in the heart of Vegas.
Staff are knowledgeable and friendly, making shopping a pleasant experience every time, with excellent product advice.

Unfortunately, the rest of our experience at Cibo was just as underwhelming. The salads we ordered were lackluster, with wilted lettuce and bland dressings. It seemed like they were phoning it in with their ingredients, relying on the trendy atmosphere to carry the meal. Our server was friendly, but seemed overwhelmed and inattentive at times, taking a while to refill drinks and clear plates. For a restaurant that prides itself on its Italian cuisine, the execution was shockingly poor. As someone who values a good pizza above all else, I was disappointed to find that Cibo's pies fell so far short of expectations. The combination of tough crust, sparse toppings, and unremarkable flavors made for a meal that was forgettable at best. Unless they seriously revamp their menu and cooking techniques, I wouldn't recommend Cibo to anyone looking for a satisfying Italian meal. The quaint ambiance and extensive drink menu are not enough to redeem the subpar food. Unless they make some significant changes, I'll be taking my pizza cravings (and my appetite) elsewhere. Overall, a disappointing experience that left a bad taste in my mouth.

The talent and dedication of the performers were evident in every aspect of the show, from the flawless vocals to the meticulous costume designs. I was particularly impressed by the attention to detail in the costumes, wigs, and makeup, which truly transformed the male performers into their female counterparts. The host's comedic interludes added a lighthearted and entertaining touch to the show, keeping the audience engaged and laughing throughout. The diverse range of performers and songs catered to a wide range of musical tastes, making it an enjoyable experience for everyone in attendance. Overall, I was thoroughly entertained and would highly recommend this show to anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable experience in Las Vegas. With its great value, talented performers, and frequent show updates, it's definitely a show I would see again and again.

The entire experience left a sour taste in our mouths, and it's clear that the restaurant is not equipped to handle large groups efficiently. The fact that they automatically add an 18% gratuity to the bill is understandable, but combining all the orders into one ticket is a recipe for disaster. It's not only inconvenient for the customers, but it also creates an opportunity for errors and disagreements. The waitress's attitude when we questioned the bill was defensive and unapologetic, which only added to the frustration. It's disappointing that a restaurant with such a great atmosphere and good food can fall short in terms of service. The Chilean Sea bass I ordered was delicious, but the horrible experience that followed overshadowed any positive aspects of the meal. The manager or supervisor was nowhere to be found during the confrontation, which suggests a lack of oversight and accountability. Overall, I would strongly advise against bringing large groups to this restaurant unless they're willing to risk a chaotic and unpleasant experience. With a little more attention to detail and a more customer-centric approach, this restaurant could have turned a potentially difficult situation into a positive one. Unfortunately, that was not the case, and our group will be taking our business elsewhere.

The staff's efficiency and helpfulness made up for the store's compact size. I appreciated the personalized service and the fact that they had all my favorite MAC items in stock. Overall, it was a quick and pleasant shopping experience, and I look forward to returning to this location for all my future MAC needs.

C'est un endroit idéal pour créer des souvenirs inoubliables avec la famille ou entre amis. Les activités sont variées et amusantes, garantissant un plaisir sans fin pour tous les âges. Le défi de battre son propre temps ajoute une touche de compétition amusante, renforçant l'envie de revenir et de relever de nouveaux défis. Tout est pensé pour offrir une expérience unique et divertissante.

I must say, my initial disappointment with the Golden Nugget's renovations has given way to a mix of emotions after seeing the website's promises of a revamped pool area. While I was looking forward to experiencing the hotel's amenities during my stay, the reality was far from it. The constant construction and "coming soon" signs made it feel like I was staying in a hotel that was still under development. However, the idea of trained dolphins and tiki hut cabanas spun from gold is undeniably exciting, and I can see why someone would want to come back and experience it. Despite the hotel's shortcomings during my visit, there were some highlights that made my stay somewhat enjoyable. The real estate conference, for instance, was well-organized and informative, and I appreciated the opportunity to learn from industry experts. The 13.99 champagne buffet brunch, although not exactly gourmet, was a fun experience, and the mimosas were a nice touch. And, of course, the in-room movie selection was a great way to pass the time, with some truly obscure films that I wouldn't have seen otherwise. But I must reiterate, the true star of the show was the world-famous bread pudding. I'm not even kidding when I say it's a must-try. It's a game-changer. If you're planning to visit the Golden Nugget, do yourself a favor and save room for dessert. With the promised renovations and additions, I'm willing to give the hotel another chance in the future. Maybe by June, when everything is supposed to be completed, the Golden Nugget will live up to its full potential. Until then, I'll just have to keep dreaming about that bread pudding and the prospect of lounging by the new pool, surrounded by trained dolphins and golden tiki huts.

I must say, the transformation in my Bloodhounds, Gunner and Gabby, is nothing short of miraculous. Before working with Nate, I was at my wit's end, feeling like I'd tried every possible solution to address their behavioral issues. But from the very first session with Nate, I knew I'd found someone special. His approach is not just about training the dogs, but also about educating the owners on how to effectively communicate with and manage their pets. One of the things that impressed me most about Nate is his patience and understanding. He took the time to explain everything in a way that made sense to me, and he never made me feel like I was doing anything wrong. He simply showed me a better way, and that made all the difference. The fact that he was willing to take Gunner in for a month to work with him one-on-one is a testament to his dedication and commitment to his craft. The results speak for themselves. Gunner's aggression is gone, and he's now a joy to be around. Both dogs are well-behaved, and they listen to commands without hesitation. We can take them on walks without being dragged down the street, and they'll even do a two-hour down-stay without any issues. It's amazing to see how far they've come, and I owe it all to Nate and his expertise. I've already recommended Nate to several friends and family members, and I'll continue to do so. His training methods are kind, gentle, and effective, and he's always available to answer questions or provide guidance whenever I need it. The group training sessions on Saturdays are also a great bonus, as they provide an opportunity for my dogs to socialize with other dogs and for me to continue learning and refining my skills. In addition to his training services, Nate's boarding facilities are top-notch. I recently had to go out of town for a week, and I was able to board my dogs with Nate without any worries. I knew they'd be well taken care of, and they'd even get to enjoy their daily walks and training sessions. It's a huge relief to know that my dogs are in good hands when I'm away. In conclusion, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to Nate for all that he's done for my family and me. He's not just a dog trainer; he's a miracle worker. If you're struggling with your dog's behavior or just want to improve your relationship with your pet, I highly recommend giving Nate a try. You won't regret it. With Innate Dog Training, you can expect proven results, a supportive community, and a trainer who truly cares about you and your dog. Thank you, Nate, for everything!

As I reflected on my experience at Great Wall, I couldn't help but compare it to my usual haunt, Golden Buddha. The dim sum at Golden Buddha is always freshly prepared and presented with a variety of options, even during off-peak hours. In contrast, the limited selection and lackluster quality of the dishes at Great Wall left me underwhelmed. The atmosphere, although bustling during peak hours, felt tired and worn by the time we arrived, with the two carts struggling to keep up with the demand. Despite my disappointment, I do want to acknowledge that the staff were friendly and apologetic, recognizing that they were running low on options. However, the overall experience was marred by the subpar food and chaotic service. For a dim sum enthusiast like myself, the thrill of the experience lies in the discovery of new flavors and the excitement of flagging down carts laden with steaming hot delicacies. Unfortunately, Great Wall failed to deliver on this front, and I found myself missing the comfort and reliability of Golden Buddha. Unless I hear that they've revamped their dim sum service, I'll be sticking to my trusted favorite. Perhaps I'll give Great Wall another chance during peak hours, but for now, I'm content to return to the familiar and satisfying experience of Golden Buddha.

The lunch buffet, while abundant in options, lacked the authenticity and flavor I've come to expect from a Thai restaurant. Each dish tasted like a watered-down version of its traditional counterpart, with the Tom Yum soup being a major letdown - it was lukewarm and devoid of the spicy kick that typically characterizes this beloved Thai dish. The Pad Thai was unrecognizable, and the orange chicken was cloyingly sweet, overpowering any other flavor that might have been present. Given the extremely affordable price point of $6.99, I can see why this place might appeal to those prioritizing quantity over quality. However, for someone who values authentic, expertly prepared Thai cuisine, this establishment falls short. As such, I wouldn't return, opting instead to drive a bit further to Spring Mountain for a genuinely satisfying Thai dining experience at Thai Style Noodle House.

We didn't have to wait long for our food, which was a plus. The portions were also generous, so we ended up taking some home. While the food wasn't particularly memorable, the prices were reasonable and the service was attentive. Our server checked in on us a few times to make sure everything was okay. If I were to come back, I'd probably try something else on the menu, like the pho or banh mi, to see if they do those dishes better. Overall, it was an average experience, but I can see why people in the area might like it as a convenient option for Vietnamese cuisine.

The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, with friendly staff who keep your coffee cup full. The menu offers a wide variety of creative dishes that will tantalize your taste buds. From omelets to waffles, each bite is a delight. I'll definitely be back to try more of their mouthwatering options and experience their exceptional service again.
The flavors are authentic and the portion is generous, making it a must-try for any Vietnamese food enthusiast like myself.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with friendly staff who always greet you with a smile. The portions are generous, and the quality of the ingredients is evident in every bite. Whether you're a local or just visiting, Peter's Cape Cod is a must-try for any seafood lover, offering an unforgettable dining experience.

Overall, I'm impressed with the improvements made at the new location. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it a great spot for a casual dinner. With its delicious Southern-style cuisine and excellent service, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a tasty meal. I'll definitely be back to try more of their menu offerings and enjoy the warm hospitality.

In retrospect, I wish I had trusted my instincts and sought a second opinion sooner. The initial diagnosis and treatment plan had left me feeling anxious and unsure about the state of my oral health. Thankfully, the second opinion revealed that my teeth and gums were in much better condition than I had been led to believe. This experience has taught me to be more vigilant and to always question any recommendations that seem excessive or overly expensive. While I appreciate the friendly staff and thorough examination, I believe it's essential for patients to be aware of the potential for overselling treatments. I would caution others to carefully review their treatment plans and consider seeking multiple opinions before committing to any costly procedures. Overall, my experience was a mixed bag, and I hope that others can learn from my mistakes and approach their dental care with a more critical eye.

As we reflected on our dining experience, we couldn't help but feel that the restaurant's pricing was a major contributor to our disappointment. With dishes priced in the $50-$60 range, we expected a level of culinary expertise and creativity that was simply not delivered. The fillet Mignon, for example, was cooked to perfection, but the presentation was lackluster and the portion size was modest at best. The Chilean Sea Bass, while fresh and flavorful, was similarly unremarkable in terms of preparation and presentation. We've had the pleasure of dining at some of the world's top restaurants, and unfortunately, this establishment fell short of our expectations. The ambiance, while elegant and sophisticated, is not enough to justify the exorbitant prices. The Wynn, as a luxury resort, should demand more from its culinary team. A restaurant of this caliber should be pushing the boundaries of culinary innovation, not serving up predictable, uninspired dishes. In contrast, the service was attentive and knowledgeable, with our server happily answering questions about the menu and making recommendations. However, even the excellent service couldn't make up for the shortcomings in the kitchen. As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, we couldn't help but feel that we had been overcharged for a dining experience that was, at best, average. Unless the chef and culinary team can elevate their game and provide a more compelling dining experience, we would not recommend this restaurant to others. With so many exceptional dining options available, it's hard to justify the expense of a meal that fails to impress.

Overall, I'd recommend the volcano nachos, but maybe ask for extra toppings to avoid the bare chip problem. With a few tweaks, this place could be a real winner for casual dining and drinks.

The entire experience was a letdown, and the lack of attention to detail and cleanliness was appalling. As someone who values a clean and comfortable stay, I was shocked and disappointed by the state of the room. The fact that the sheets were not changed and the mattress cover had hair and other stains on it is unacceptable. It's not like we were asking for much, just a clean and fresh room to rest in. The addition of the vomit smell coming from the air vent was just the cherry on top of a disastrous stay. The check-in process was also a hassle, with the extra fee for checking in just an hour early being a ridiculous charge. It's not like we were asking to check in at an unreasonable hour, just a simple hour ahead of schedule. The front desk staff seemed unbothered by our concerns and didn't even offer a sincere apology. The maid service manager's response was lackluster, and it's clear that the hotel is not taking the cleanliness and satisfaction of their guests seriously. Overall, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone and will be taking my business elsewhere. The lack of attention to detail and cleanliness is a major red flag, and I would advise others to think twice before booking a stay here.

As I reflected on my experience at Pizzeria Bianco, I couldn't help but think that the hype surrounding this institution is not only justified but also necessary. It's a place that has captured the hearts and taste buds of pizza enthusiasts, chefs, and celebrities alike, and for good reason. The combination of Chris Bianco's passion for traditional Neapolitan-style pizza, the cozy and intimate atmosphere, and the exceptional quality of the ingredients all come together to create a truly unforgettable experience. One of the things that struck me most about Pizzeria Bianco was the attention to detail that goes into every aspect of the restaurant. From the carefully curated selection of wines and craft beers to the eclectic decor of the waiting area, it's clear that every element has been thoughtfully considered to create a unique and immersive experience for guests. And then, of course, there's the pizza itself – perfectly cooked, flavorful, and expertly balanced, with each bite a masterclass in texture and taste. I've had my fair share of pizza in my lifetime, but Pizzeria Bianco's offerings are in a league of their own. The white pizza, with its delicate balance of creamy mozzarella, fragrant garlic, and fresh arugula, was a revelation – a testament to the power of simplicity and restraint in cooking. The margherita, with its classic combination of San Marzano tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil, was equally impressive, with each ingredient shining in perfect harmony. And the "mainly meat" pizza, with its rich prosciutto and savory mushrooms, was a hearty and satisfying delight. What's perhaps most remarkable about Pizzeria Bianco, however, is the way it has managed to maintain its integrity and commitment to quality despite the overwhelming demand and attention it has received. In an era where restaurants are often tempted to compromise on ingredients, portion sizes, or cooking techniques in order to keep up with the crowds, Pizzeria Bianco remains steadfast in its dedication to traditional methods and exceptional ingredients. It's a testament to the power of passion and perseverance, and a reminder that, with hard work and attention to detail, even the smallest and most humble of restaurants can achieve greatness. In short, Pizzeria Bianco is a must-visit destination for anyone who loves pizza, cooking, or simply great food. It's a place that will leave you inspired, delighted, and perhaps even a little changed – a culinary pilgrimage that will stay with you long after you've finished your meal and left the restaurant. So, as I said earlier, get on the next flight to AZ, or hop in your car and drive down the 101. Trust me, the wait will be worth it.

The staff were friendly and attentive, making our stay even more enjoyable. We took advantage of the beautiful pool area and enjoyed the scenic views of the fountain show from our room at night. The location of the Bellagio is also perfect, with easy access to other hotels and attractions on the strip. We did experience some delays at check-in, but the hotel's amenities and services made up for it. The room service was prompt and the food was delicious. Overall, our stay at the Bellagio was an unforgettable experience and we can't wait to go back. The combination of luxury, comfort, and entertainment makes it a top choice for anyone visiting Las Vegas. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just looking for a relaxing getaway, the Bellagio is sure to impress. We highly recommend it to anyone looking for a high-end hotel experience.

As I paddled along the Allegheny River, I couldn't help but feel a sense of awe at the stunning views of the Pittsburgh skyline. The sun was shining, casting a warm glow over the city, and the occasional cloud provided a welcome respite from the heat. I had chosen to head down towards the point, and as I paddled alongside the submarine by the Science Center, I felt like I was in a different world. The surreal experience of being next to such an impressive vessel was exhilarating, and I couldn't help but take a moment to appreciate the unique perspective on the city that kayaking provided. As I continued on my journey, I noticed the variety of wildlife that calls the river home. I spotted a few fish swimming in the water, and even caught a glimpse of a bird or two soaring overhead. The peacefulness of the river was a welcome change from the hustle and bustle of city life, and I found myself feeling relaxed and at ease as I paddled along. The sound of the water lapping against the kayak and the occasional cry of a seagull were the only sounds I needed to feel completely at peace. One of the things that I appreciate most about Kayak Pittsburgh is the convenience and accessibility of their location. As I mentioned earlier, it's just a short walk from PNC Park, and the staff is always friendly and helpful. They provide everything you need to get started, from the kayak and paddle to the life vest and safety instructions. They even offer tips and advice for navigating the river, which is especially helpful for beginners. As I paddled back upriver, I couldn't help but think about how much I loved this city. Pittsburgh has a way of surprising you, whether it's the stunning views from the top of Mount Washington or the vibrant cultural scene in the Strip District. And kayaking on the river is just one more way to experience all that the city has to offer. Whether you're a native Pittsburgher or just visiting, I highly recommend adding Kayak Pittsburgh to your list of things to do. It's an experience you won't soon forget, and one that will leave you feeling refreshed, renewed, and ready to take on whatever the city has in store. In addition to the scenic views and relaxing atmosphere, kayaking on the river also provides a great workout. Paddling against the current can be challenging, but it's a great way to build strength and endurance. And the sense of accomplishment you feel when you finally make it back to the dock is unbeatable. Whether you're looking for a fun and relaxing activity or a challenging workout, kayaking on the river has something to offer. As I finished up my kayaking trip and returned to the dock, I couldn't help but feel grateful for the experience. Kayak Pittsburgh had provided me with a unique and memorable experience, and I couldn't wait to get back out on the water again. With its convenient location, friendly staff, and stunning views, Kayak Pittsburgh is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to experience the best of Pittsburgh. So why not get out there and start paddling? I promise you won't regret it!

The atmosphere is lively and authentic, making it a perfect spot for any occasion. Friendly staff, generous portions, and mouthwatering dishes will keep you coming back for more, just like I do, every chance I get, to indulge in their incredible Mexican cuisine.

As I sat on the monorail, feeling queasy and disappointed, I couldn't help but think that our experience at Battista's was a major letdown. The food, although my wife enjoyed her dish, was subpar and overpriced. The atmosphere, while quaint and nostalgic, couldn't make up for the lackluster cuisine. And don't even get me started on the little man with the accordion - it was a bizarre and uncomfortable experience. I've been to plenty of Italian restaurants in my day, and Battista's just didn't cut it. The fettucine alfredo was a disappointment, and the fact that I started feeling sick after eating it was a major red flag. I'm not sure if it was the food itself or something else, but it was definitely a turning point in our evening. We had been having such a great time in Vegas, exploring the city and trying new restaurants. Ellis Island and the Gold Coast buffet were highlights of our trip, and we were excited to try more local eateries. But Battista's was a misstep, and I would caution others against wasting their time and money. In retrospect, I wish we had taken the reviews more seriously and avoided Battista's altogether. The warnings about the accordion player and the overpriced food were spot on, and we should have listened. Instead, we ended up with a disappointing and expensive meal that ruined our evening. If you're looking for good Italian food in Vegas, keep looking. There are plenty of other options that are sure to satisfy your cravings without breaking the bank. And if you're a fan of Bally's, like we are, there are plenty of other great restaurants and attractions to explore in the area. In conclusion, our experience at Battista's was a major disappointment, and I would not recommend it to anyone. With so many other great options available in Vegas, it's just not worth the risk. Stick with the tried and true favorites, like Ellis Island and the Gold Coast buffet, and avoid this overpriced and underwhelming Italian restaurant.
The service was also appalling, with rude staff and long wait times, making the overall experience utterly unbearable and regrettable, leaving a lasting bad impression.

As I reflect on my overall experience, I'm left with mixed emotions. On one hand, I adore the unique theme, decor, and uniforms - it's clear that Rick Moonen's team has put a lot of thought into creating an immersive atmosphere. The inventive drink menu is also a highlight, with some truly standout options. And, of course, the mac and cheese is an absolute must-try - it's creamy, crunchy, and utterly delicious. On the other hand, the food is a bit of a mixed bag. While the chick pot pie nuggets and fried oxtail show promise, they ultimately fall short due to flavor imbalances. The French Onion Dip Sandwich is a particular disappointment, lacking the richness and depth that I've come to expect from a dish like this. It's clear that the kitchen is still experimenting and refining their recipes, which is understandable given that the restaurant is still in its early days. The service, too, is a work in progress. While the hostesses are friendly and stylish, our server seemed a bit disorganized and inattentive. The fact that our appetizers arrived before our drinks not once, but twice, is a bit baffling. However, the "apprentice" who assisted with water service was a bright spot, providing excellent recommendations and a warm, friendly demeanor. The surprise visit from Rick Moonen himself was a lovely touch, and it's clear that he's committed to making a personal connection with his customers. As the restaurant continues to find its footing, I'm hopeful that this level of attention and care will become more consistent throughout the dining experience. For now, I'd recommend RM Seafood downstairs for a more polished and refined dining experience. However, if you're in the area and looking for a fun, casual spot to grab appetizers or drinks, this new restaurant might be worth a try. Just be aware that they're still working out the kinks, and be sure to order that mac and cheese - it's a game-changer. In six months or so, I'd love to return and see how the restaurant has evolved. With a bit more time to refine their menu and service, I have no doubt that this place will become a top destination in Mandalay Shoppes. Until then, I'll be keeping an eye on their progress and looking forward to my next visit. For now, I'd give this restaurant 3.5 stars - a solid effort, but not quite a home run just yet.
